description:
CapVox AI is a US company that helps med spas bring back past clients and book appointments using AI text,
, and voice agents. We are hiring an experienced cold caller to call US med spa owners and book short setup calls with our team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make
+ dials per day using a parallel dialer (training provided)

- Get past the front desk and reach the spa owner or manager

- Follow our proven script to book 15-minute setup calls

- Log every call and note in our CRM

- Join a weekly call review to improve your results



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting for US clients (med spa, solar, home services, real estate, or agency experience is a plus)

- Clear, confident spoken English and a friendly phone voice

- Comfortable with rejection and high call volume

- Able to work US Eastern Time business hours, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

- Quiet workspace, headset with noise cancelling, stable internet, and backup power



PAY

- Base salary plus a bonus for every setup call that is held

- Top performers can earn significantly above base

- Long-term role with room to grow into a team lead position



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the exact words "Med Spa Caller Role" in the subject line so we know you read this post.

2. Tell us your cold calling experience: what industry, how many dials per day, and how many appointments per week you booked.

3. Include a link to a 60-second video or voice recording (Loom, Vocaroo, or similar) where you introduce yourself and pitch any product as if you were on a cold call.



Applications without the video or audio recording will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will do a live mock cold call with us.

title: Real Estate Investor Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant — Real Estate Investments

Quebec LLC

Remote | Independent Contractor | Task-Based / Flexible Hours

About the Role

I'm the Manager of Quebec LLC, which owns and operates a growing real estate investment portfolio — currently 4 residential rental buildings — alongside our drywall business. I'm looking for a personal assistant with real estate knowledge to support me directly in this role: keeping my calendar and admin organized, keeping the financial and reporting side current, and acting as the point of contact for tenant and vendor communication so I can focus on the bigger decisions. This is a remote, flexible role, similar in spirit to the estimator assistant who already supports the drywall side of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Admin & Scheduling Support

• Manage my calendar and schedule calls/meetings with tenants, contractors, vendors, and property managers.

• Prepare for meetings — pull together notes, background, and follow-up items.

• Keep general administrative tasks organized (filing, records, reminders) as the portfolio grows.

Financial & Reporting

• Maintain a monthly cost-per-unit spreadsheet across all 4 buildings (utilities, maintenance, insurance, property tax, management fees, etc.).

• Track rent billing and tenant charges, and help reconcile payments received against what's owed.

• Prepare simple, regular reports summarizing portfolio performance — income, expenses, and cost per unit by building.

Tenant & Vendor Communication

• Manage the shared portfolio
 inbox: triage, respond to routine tenant and vendor
s, and flag anything needing my direct attention.

• Log and track tenant repair/maintenance requests from intake through completion, following up with tenants and contractors as needed.

• Coordinate scheduling and follow-up with contractors and vendors.

What We're Looking For

• Working knowledge of real estate and property management — familiarity with leases, tenant relations, rent rolls, and basic real estate terminology is required.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable managing a calendar, inbox, and multiple recurring tasks at once.

• Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial tracking and reporting.

• Excellent written English for professional tenant, vendor, and client communication.

• Reliable and responsive during agreed working hours; comfortable with async, remote work.

• Prior experience as a personal/executive/virtual assistant, ideally supporting a business owner or in property management, is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with tools like QuickBooks, Buildium, AppFolio, or a shared calendar/email platform (e.g. Google Workspace) is a plus but not required.

Role Details

Company: Quebec LLC

Location: Remote (open to candidates worldwide)

Engagement: Independent contractor, task-based / flexible hours based on monthly workload

Portfolio size: 4 residential buildings (unit count to be shared with candidates)

Tools provided: Shared spreadsheet templates, portfolio
 and calendar access, and access to relevant records

Reports to: Francois, Manager, Quebec LLC



Make sure to name the City where we purchased our last property which can be find on
, this will be the only way that i will be responding to your application, since i'm looking for someone who really pay attention to details .

Learn and implement new tools, platforms, and technologies quickly



AI & TECHNOLOGY

Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, CapCut, AI image/video tools, automation tools, and social media scheduling platforms is a strong advantage.



You don't need to know every tool already.



However, you must be willing and able to learn new AI tools quickly.

"There has to be a faster and smarter way to do this."

Our ideal candidate is:



Tech-savvy

Detail-oriented

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

Professional and fast-paced environment

"I AM TECH-SAVVY AND READY TO GROW."

title: Book Keeper
description:
Senior Australian Bookkeeper – Permanent Part-Time – Philippines **PREFERED START - 12th of October 2026 **



Location: Philippines – Work from Home

Hours: 25 hours per week

Position: Permanent, long-term

Pay: AUD $12–$15 per hour, depending on experience and capability

Australian business hours: Required



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Australian Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to join our business on a permanent, long-term basis.



This is not a basic data-entry bookkeeping role. We are looking for someone who has genuine Australian bookkeeping experience and can confidently manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple Australian businesses and entities.



We are prepared to pay up to AUD $15 per hour for the right candidate and are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to take ownership of their work.



Essential Experience



You must have:



- Minimum 5 years' bookkeeping/accounting experience

- Proven experience working with Australian businesses

- Strong Xero experience

- MYOB experience, preferably MYOB AccountRight

- Australian GST and BAS knowledge

- Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience

- Bank and credit-card reconciliations

- Accounts payable and accounts receivable

- General ledger and journal entries

- Month-end bookkeeping

- Profit & loss and balance-sheet reporting

- Strong Excel skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to work independently and accurately

- Excellent attention to detail



Highly Desirable



Experience with:



- Multiple Australian companies and entities

- Trust accounting

- Intercompany transactions and loans

- Inventory accounting

- E-commerce businesses

- Shopify

- Dext/Hubdoc

- Australian accountants and accounting firms

- Management reporting and budgeting

- MYOB AccountRight

- Preparing information for Australian tax accountants

- Identifying bookkeeping discrepancies and correcting errors



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for assisting with:



- Daily bookkeeping

- Bank and credit-card reconciliations

- Accounts payable and receivable

- Invoicing and payments

- Payroll and superannuation

- GST and BAS preparation

- Intercompany transactions

- Reconciliation of company and trust accounts

- Maintaining accurate Xero/MYOB records

- Month-end accounts

- P&L and balance-sheet reporting

- Preparing reports and information for our Australian accountant

- Reviewing transactions and identifying discrepancies

- Maintaining organised financial records

- Assisting with budgets, forecasts and cash-flow reporting

- Other bookkeeping and accounting administration as required



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



Reliable – Accurate – Honest – Organised – Proactive – Confidential – Detail-oriented



You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work rather than needing constant supervision.



We are particularly interested in someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship and become an important part of the business.



Working Arrangement



- Permanent long-term position

- 25 hours per week

- Work from your own home in the Philippines

- Australian business-hours availability required

- Stable and consistent weekly hours

- Opportunity for additional hours as the business grows

- Competitive rate of AUD $12–$15/hour

- AUD $15/hour available for an exceptional candidate



Application Requirements



Please send:



1. Your CV

2. A brief summary of your Australian bookkeeping experience

3. Number of years working with Australian businesses

4. Your experience with Xero and MYOB

5. Your Australian BAS/GST/payroll experience

6. Your current availability and preferred working hours

7. Your expected hourly rate in AUD

8. Two recent professional references, preferably from Australian clients or employers

9. Details of your computer, internet and work-from-home setup



Important



Please only apply if you have genuine Australian bookkeeping experience.



Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a short practical bookkeeping assessment using a fictional Australian business. This will assess Xero/MYOB knowledge, Australian bookkeeping, reconciliations, GST/BAS understanding and attention to detail.



We are looking for the right long-term person, not simply the cheapest applicant.



If you are an experienced Australian bookkeeper who wants a stable, respectful and long-term work-from-home position, we would love to hear from you.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can independently plan, build, manage and optimize
 marketing and paid social campaigns that help us acquire customers, convert interest into sales and retain existing customers.



You should be comfortable working with growing brands where systems are still being developed. We need someone who can identify opportunities, recommend what should be done, implement it, monitor performance and continuously improve results — not someone who requires step-by-step instructions for every task.



Our two brands serve very different audiences, so you must be able to understand and maintain the distinct identity, customer journey and marketing strategy of each.



The workload will vary between
 marketing and Meta Ads depending on current campaigns and priorities. Additional hours may occasionally be available during launches or periods of increased marketing activity, with prior approval.



About the Brands



Alyssis Kids Universe (AKU) is a children's brand focused on stories and products that help children develop skills such as calm, patience, kindness, curiosity and early financial literacy. The brand includes children's books, characters, educational products and other products being developed around the AKU universe.



Ola Jewelry is a women's jewelry e-commerce brand offering stylish, accessible jewelry for everyday looks, special occasions and gifting.



1.
 Marketing — Primary Responsibility



You will manage and improve
 marketing for both brands.



Both brands currently use Omnisend. Strong hands-on experience with Omnisend is preferred. Candidates with substantial experience using comparable e-commerce
 platforms such as Klaviyo may also be considered if they can demonstrate strong automation, segmentation and e-commerce
 marketing skills.



Responsibilities include:



Set up, manage and optimize Omnisend campaigns and automations



Review existing
 flows and identify opportunities for improvement



Build branded
 campaigns appropriate for each business



Create and maintain automated customer journeys



Develop useful customer segments



Write compelling subject lines,
 copy and calls to action



Build visually appropriate
 templates for each brand



Plan
 calendars around launches, promotions, seasonal opportunities and customer journeys



Grow and maintain healthy subscriber lists



Conduct A/B testing



Monitor deliverability and list health



Track
 revenue and conversion performance



Review performance and recommend improvements



You should understand and be able to build and optimize key e-commerce flows including:



Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Abandoned Checkout, Browse Abandonment, Post-Purchase, Review/UGC Requests, Cross-Sell/Upsell, Win-Back, Back-in-Stock, Product Launch/VIP and Re-engagement.



You should understand that AKU and Ola Jewelry are very different brands and be able to create
 experiences appropriate to each audience rather than using the same messaging and templates for both.



AKU speaks primarily to parents, caregivers and gift buyers purchasing children's products.



Ola Jewelry speaks primarily to women shopping for themselves as well as customers purchasing jewelry as gifts.



You should understand how those differences affect messaging, creative, offers, segmentation and customer journeys.



2. Meta Ads — Primary Responsibility



You will also manage paid advertising across Instagram and
 through Meta Ads Manager.



Responsibilities include:



Set up, launch and manage Meta advertising campaigns



Recommend appropriate campaign objectives based on our goals



Develop customer acquisition and retargeting strategies



Build and test audiences



Create Custom and Lookalike Audiences where appropriate



Collaborate with our content creator on ad creative



Recommend the types of content and creative needed for advertising



Write and test ad copy, hooks, headlines and CTAs



Test different creative concepts and formats



Manage advertising budgets responsibly



Monitor campaign performance



Identify underperforming campaigns and make adjustments



Scale successful campaigns appropriately



Ensure Pixel, events and conversion tracking are functioning correctly



Provide clear, simple reporting on results



You should be comfortable discussing metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM and conversion rate and, more importantly, explaining what those numbers mean and what you would change based on them.



We do not simply want someone who can report numbers. We want someone who can answer questions such as:



What happened?

Why do you think it happened?

What should we change?

What should we test next?



3. E-commerce Conversion & Tracking



Because the goal of our marketing is ultimately to generate sales, you should understand the relationship between advertising, website traffic,
 marketing and conversion.



You should be comfortable reviewing and troubleshooting:



Meta Pixel and conversion events



Purchase tracking



Retargeting audiences



Product catalogs where applicable



 attribution



Campaign tracking



Landing and product-page performance



Customer journey from ad/email click through purchase



You do not need to be a website developer, but you should be able to identify when tracking, website or conversion issues may be affecting campaign performance.



4. Team Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer



You will work closely with our content creator, who supports both brands.



The specialist will continue to own the more technical and performance-focused aspects of
 marketing and Meta Ads, but we also want to build appropriate marketing capabilities within our existing team over time.



You should be comfortable:



Giving our content creator clear direction on the creative assets needed for
 campaigns and Meta Ads



Explaining campaign decisions and requirements in a way that is easy to understand



Sharing relevant processes and best practices



Providing simple documentation for recurring tasks where appropriate



Helping our content creator learn appropriate recurring execution tasks that can gradually be handled internally



We are looking for someone who is comfortable sharing knowledge and collaborating rather than operating in a silo.



This does not mean transferring responsibility for strategy, technical setup or performance optimization. The specialist will remain responsible for the areas that require specialist expertise.



5. SEO — Nice to Have



SEO experience is an advantage but is not required.



If you have experience with any of the following, please tell us about it:



Keyword research



Product-page optimization



Metadata



On-page SEO



Shopify SEO



Google Search Console



E-commerce content optimization



Lack of advanced SEO experience will not disqualify an otherwise strong candidate.



What We're Looking For



The strongest candidate will have practical experience managing
 marketing and Meta Ads for e-commerce or consumer brands.



Experience with any of the following would be particularly valuable:



Jewelry



Fashion/accessories



Children's products



Books



Parenting/family brands



Lifestyle brands



Direct-to-consumer e-commerce



You should be able to show work you personally executed — not simply campaigns managed by an agency or a larger team.



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive and able to work independently



Analytical but commercially minded



Organized and reliable



Comfortable making recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions



Able to prioritize effectively within approximately 10 hours per week



Able to manage two distinct brands without confusing their customers, messaging or campaigns



Comfortable collaborating with and providing guidance to our content creator



Focused on measurable business results rather than simply completing tasks



You should be able to identify opportunities and explain what you recommend doing, why you recommend it and how you will determine whether it worked.



Selection Process



Candidates who are shortlisted will be invited to complete a paid skills assessment capped at 4 hours.



The assessment will focus on practical
 marketing, Meta Ads and e-commerce problem-solving using scenarios relevant to our brands.



The purpose of the assessment is to understand how you think, make marketing decisions and apply your experience in practice. You will not be given access to our live Omnisend, Meta Ads or other business accounts during the assessment.



Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their recommendations and decision-making during a follow-up interview.



To Apply



Please include:



Your CV/resume and portfolio, if available.



Your experience with Omnisend or other e-commerce
 marketing platforms. If you have not used Omnisend specifically but have strong experience with another platform, explain which one.



Examples/screenshots of
 campaigns or automated flows you personally built.



Any measurable
 marketing results you can substantiate.



Your experience managing Meta Ads for e-commerce brands.



Examples/screenshots of Meta campaigns you personally managed and the results.



The approximate monthly advertising budgets you have previously managed.



Briefly describe one Meta campaign that was not performing well, what you identified as the problem, what you changed and what happened afterward.



Briefly describe one
 campaign or automated flow you improved and the result.



Which performance metrics you normally monitor for
 marketing and Meta Ads.



Which e-commerce platforms you have worked with, such as Shopify or WooCommerce.



Briefly describe your experience collaborating with content creators or other team members.



Your availability and expected hourly/monthly rate for approximately 10 hours per week.



Please clearly indicate what you personally created and managed where other team members were involved.



Generic applications that do not address the questions above may not be considered.

title: Transaction Coordinator – Non-QM Mortgage (DSCR / Bank Statement / Investor Loans) | AI-Forward Team
description:
We're MV Corporate, a U.S.-based real estate, private lending, and investment company. We fund investor loans (DSCR, bank statement, bridge, fix-and-flip) and we run on an AI-powered team. We're hiring a Transaction Coordinator to keep every file moving from contract to clear-to-close. You'll be the person borrowers, brokers, lenders, and title companies count on for a straight answer.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

We use AI tools every day for inbox triage, condition tracking, document review, and drafting. We are not looking for someone to retype checklists. We want someone who looks at a file, figures out what is actually missing, uses AI to move faster, and then picks up the phone to close the gap. A sharp coordinator who embraces AI will outperform a veteran who resists it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own non-QM and investor loan files from submission through clear-to-close, handling several files each month

- Track conditions, deadlines, and contract milestones; know what's missing before anyone asks

- Call and
 borrowers, brokers, lenders, title/escrow, insurance, and appraisal contacts

- Review documents for completeness: spot missing pages, signature errors, and mismatched entity details before underwriting does

- Keep GoHighLevel and Google Drive accurate and current

- Use AI tools to draft updates, summarize documents, and automate repeat tasks

- Send a daily end-of-day update: done, pending, needs attention

- Flag at-risk files early, with a recommendation, not just a question



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- AI tools and workflows already built for the work

- Full SOPs and video walkthroughs

- Your own CRM login and a company

- Training on how we do things, plus real autonomy. We care that files close.



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years of U.S. real estate experience, residential mainly

- Background in loan processing at a lending bank, a mortgage office or brokerage, or a real estate firm (bank-level processing experience is a big plus)

- Ability to process several loan files a month with accuracy and speed

- Working knowledge of non-QM, DSCR, or investor loans, and TRID/closing timelines

- Experience with an LOS and a CRM (GoHighLevel is a plus)

- Excellent spoken and written English; this role is on the phone with U.S. borrowers every day

- Comfort using AI tools, and the curiosity to keep learning them

- Organized, decisive, and thick-skinned; you follow up without reminders

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

- Available during U.S. Central Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

Entity-borrowing knowledge (LLCs, trusts), title/escrow coordination, private or hard money exposure.



AUTHORITY BOUNDARY

You coordinate and organize. You do not approve loans, quote terms, or give lending advice. Those decisions stay with leadership.



GROWTH

Strong performers move into full pipeline ownership and team-lead roles as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly)

1. Start your message with the word TRACKER.

2. Tell us where you worked (lending bank, mortgage office, or real estate firm), your years of U.S. residential experience, and roughly how many loan files you process per month.

3. Describe a time you chased a missing condition or document to the finish. What did you do?

4. How do you use AI in your work today? Name the tool, the task, and what it saved you.

5. Include your resume link and a 60-second voice or video introduction.



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

You will primarily be editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts featuring talking-head, educational, entertainment, and personality-driven content.



This is an ongoing position for someone who can consistently produce high-quality videos with a fast turnaround.



What You'll Be Doing

title: Short-Form Content Editor … Instagram Reels (8 hrs/week, room to grow)
description:
WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



A short-form content editor to take over the editing and trial testing of my Instagram reels, so I can post more often than I currently manage.



Roughly 95% of my content is talking-head founder-led reels. Me to camera. That's the format you'd be working in almost every day.



I run a structured system and I'll give you a format to follow. But I'm looking for someone with real aesthetic taste, not just a pair of hands. The better your eye, the more say you'll have over time.



ABOUT ME



I'm Will, an Australian carpenter and founder of Tradie Talk, an app for the trades. I'm on camera, I write the hooks, and Instagram is the main growth channel for the business.



This is my first hire.



THE GOAL



I want 4 to 7 main reels a week on the grid. I'm not hitting that right now. I've run near-daily posting before, but I've been inconsistent lately because I'm doing everything myself.



That's the whole reason for this role. More volume, consistently, without it all going through me.



HOW IT WORKS



Each main reel also gets 2 to 5 trial variants … same footage, changed hook text, cover frame, opening seconds or audio.



Most of the time trials go out first. I run the variants, see which lands, then the winner goes to the main grid. Sometimes I'll skip that and post straight to main when I'm confident or short on time. I'll tell you which way each batch is going.



Main reels go out across all platforms. Trial variants are Instagram only.



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES



4 to 7 main reels, cut and captioned

2 to 5 trial variants of each

One weekly performance report



Every file: 1080x1920, captions burned in, Australian spelling, no typos, named to a system I'll give you, dropped in a shared folder. 48-hour turnaround from when I send footage.



Volume moves with how much I film. Some weeks are heavier.



THE EDITING STANDARD



My grid has to look consistent. There's a fixed format for the standard edits … caption style, pacing, treatment. You follow it.



The higher-production variants are where you get creative freedom, but they still have to sit on the grid without looking out of place. Same visual language, more effort behind it. If a reel looks great on its own and wrong next to the five before it, it's failed.



So you need an eye for aesthetics, not just editing skill. You'll be working to my profile's look, and you need to understand short-form formatting … hook placement, cut rhythm, text timing, where people drop off, and what holds attention on a talking-head video specifically. If you've got ideas on the look and layout, I want to hear them. Earn it on the basics first and I'll back you to run with them.



PERFORMANCE REPORTING



One report a week. Top performers, what's not working, what you'd test next.



I'm hiring to take this off my plate, not to be walked through every metric. You need to read Instagram insights and understand them well enough to act on them yourself. Use AI for the heavy lifting if it makes you faster … I care that you know when the output is wrong.



HOW I WORK WITH PEOPLE



I value honesty and transparency over looking good.

What You'll Be Selling

Other business automation services

Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers



Understand each prospect’s business, pain points, goals, and budget



Present our services clearly and professionally

Build value before discussing price

Strong previous sales-closing experience



Experience closing sales by phone or video call



Excellent spoken English



Clear and professional communication



Strong objection-handling skills



Confidence speaking with business owners



Ability to think quickly during sales conversations



Ability to control and guide a sales call



Strong follow-up skills



Ability to take multiple sales calls per day



Reliable internet, computer, microphone/headset, and quiet work environment



Strong organization and time-management skills



Ability to work independently without constant supervision



Experience selling websites, digital marketing, SaaS, AI, automation, SEO, advertising, or B2B services is highly preferred.



Compensation



Hourly Pay: $4–$5 USD per hour



PLUS Commission: 10%–15% on successfully closed deals



Commission is paid in addition to your hourly compensation.



Examples:



Close a $500 deal → $50–$75 commission



Close a $750 deal → $75–$112.50 commission



Close a $1,500 deal → $150–$225 commission



Close a $3,000 deal → $300–$450 commission



There is no commission cap.



The stronger your performance, the more you can earn.



High-performing closers may become eligible for:



Higher commission percentages



Performance bonuses



More scheduled appointments



Increased hours



Additional responsibilities



Long-term opportunities within the agency



Schedule



This will initially be a part-time remote position.



You must be available during U.S. business hours, particularly Central Time, because appointments may be scheduled throughout the business day.



Your schedule may vary depending on appointment volume.



You must be flexible enough to take multiple scheduled calls when needed.



Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who takes sales seriously.



Performance will be measured through:



Call attendance



Closing percentage



Revenue generated



Follow-up performance



Communication quality



CRM accuracy



Professionalism



Ability to handle objections



Overall consistency



What We're NOT Looking For



We're not looking for someone who:



Has little or no sales experience



Requires a script for every situation



Is uncomfortable discussing pricing



Gives up after the first objection



Cannot confidently lead a sales conversation



Has poor English communication



Frequently misses scheduled calls



Is uncomfortable speaking directly with business owners



You should understand that objections such as:



“It's too expensive.”



“I need to think about it.”



“I need to talk to my partner.”



“Send me some information.”



“I'm comparing other companies.”



are normal parts of the sales process.



We expect our closer to know how to professionally uncover the real objection and continue the conversation.



How to Apply



Please include:

Your previous sales and closing experience



What products or services you have previously sold



Your approximate closing percentage, if known



The largest deal you have personally closed



Examples of objections you regularly handled



Your availability in U.S. Central Time



A short voice or video introduction



Any proof of previous sales results you can provide

title: Senior Tax Accountant (Australia)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



- CPA qualification is a BIG PLUS.

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS



Xero | Xero Tax | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



EMPLOYEE BENEFITS



* Independent Contractor (no payroll deductions)

* 100% reimbursed government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) — you pay your contributions directly, and you will be reimbursed the full amount, so there is no deduction from your salary

* 13th-month pay

* HMO coverage

* Paid leaves and paid holidays

* Fully remote setup



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your résumé and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Senior Accountant (Australia)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior hands-on accounting role responsible for multi-entity financial control, month-end close, management reporting, cash flow and working capital, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and process improvement. Works across transactional accounting through to consolidated and executive reporting.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Deliver a four-business-day month-end close covering journals, accruals, prepayments, AP, AR, cash, payroll accounts, fixed assets, provisions, cutoff, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

- Prepare entity-level and consolidated management accounts, including intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow reporting.

- Perform P&L, balance-sheet, budget, and forecast variance analysis across revenue, expenses, etc.

- Build and maintain short-term and 13-week cash-flow forecasts.

- Manage working capital, including AR aging, collections, AP payment timing, etc.

- Coordinate AP and AR activities to ensure transactional work supports month-end and reporting deadlines.

- Prepare budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario models, KPIs, dashboards, and management reports with clear financial commentary.

- Analyze the financial impact of pricing, hiring, inventory, capex, investment, and growth decisions.

- Maintain fixed assets, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, GL reconciliation, and audit support; review expenditure for capex versus opex classification.

- Support multi-currency accounting, period-end remeasurement, FX gains/losses, and group reporting.

- Reconcile billing and payment activity to customer balances, revenue, cash receipts, and the general ledger.

- Improve high-volume accounting and reconciliation processes using automation, electronic matching, Power Query, and exception-based review.

- BIG PLUS: Use AI tools for financial modelling, analysis, reporting, and visualisation while independently validating outputs.



REQUIREMENTS



- Accounting or Finance degree; CPA qualification/licence required.

- Strong management accounting, month-end close, multi-entity consolidation, and financial reporting experience.

- Strong cash-flow forecasting, working-capital management, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modelling skills.

- Strong knowledge of AP, AR, collections, banking, reconciliations, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and multi-currency accounting.

- Advanced Excel and Power Query; strong MYOB and Xero experience.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools for financial analysis and reporting.

- Strong English communication, analytical judgment, and ability to independently investigate financial issues and provide practical recommendations.



EMPLOYEE BENEFITS



- Independent Contractor (no payroll deductions)

- 100% reimbursed government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) — you pay your contributions directly, and you will be reimbursed the full amount, so there is no deduction from your salary

- 13th-month pay

- HMO coverage

- Paid leaves and paid holidays

- Fully remote setup



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your résumé and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Short form clipper
description:
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented short-form video editor to turn our long-form podcast episodes into engaging clips for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn. This is from the YouTube channel: (link removed)



This is not a basic captioning or repurposing role. We’re looking for someone who can take strong 
nts from a podcast and turn them into short, punchy, engaging videos using smart editing, strong hooks, creative visuals, transitions, images, B-roll, graphics, and tight storytelling.



Role Overview



You will be responsible for creating 90 short-form video clips per month from our long-form podcast content.



Each clip should feel polished, engaging, and intentionally edited — not just auto-generated captions placed over a podcast clip. The clips tend to be between 20-60 seconds.



The target audience is experts, consultants and online coaches trying to get clients without social media. They are problem aware of not getting clients, and not succeeding on social media...but not yet solution aware that there are better ways (such as our method, 15-minute solo podcasts). The role of the short form content is to meet them where they're at, and make them more aware.



Responsibilities

1. Create Short-Form Podcast Clips



You will create 90 short-form videos per month from long-form podcast episodes.



Each clip should:



Capture a clear, valuable idea from the podcast

Have a strong hook, clear body, and satisfying payoff

Be edited for attention and retention

Feel unique, creative, and shareable

Be ready to post across short-form platforms



2. Edit for Punch and Clarity



You will be expected to:



Remove filler words, long pauses, and unnecessary gaps

Tighten the wording so each clip feels fast-paced and engaging

Rearrange or trim sections where needed to improve flow

Make each clip as short, sharp, and clear as possible

Ensure the opening hook grabs attention quickly for the target audience



3. Add Creative Visual Elements



We are not looking for basic AI clips with captions only.



Each video should include creative editing elements where appropriate, such as:



B-roll

Extra footage

Images

Graphics

Zooms

Transitions

Pattern interrupts

On-screen emphasis

Visual storytelling elements



The goal is to make the clip feel engaging and intentional, not generic.



4. Quality Control



Before submitting clips, you will need to make sure each video is:



Cleanly edited

Easy to understand

Visually engaging

Aligned with our brand and audience

Free from awkward cuts, errors, or unnecessary filler

Ready to publish



Compensation is $500 per month for 90 short-form video clips per month.



To apply, please submit:



1. A sample short video (as a shareable link for us to view) created from the podcast content provided here:









2. And a written justification as to why the hook appeals to our target audience (experts, consultants and online coaches trying to get clients without social media), and exactly what the payoff of the video is. This helps us understand how you think.



Applications that only submit an AI-generated clip with captions and no extra creativity, visuals, transitions, images, graphics, or editing effort will not be considered. To be considered, your submission must adhere to all of the standards mentioned above.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About TLC Nursing

Founded in 2006 by a Registered Nurse, TLC Nursing is a nurse-owned and operated leader in travel healthcare and allied health staffing across the United States. Dedicated to cultivating meaningful relationships and delivering exceptional healthcare staffing solutions, TLC Nursing bridges critical staffing gaps in hospitals, long-term care facilities, and healthcare systems nationwide.   

As we continue to expand our national footprint, leverage new healthcare technologies, and scale our operational model, we are seeking a battle-tested, visionary Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join our executive leadership team.



The Role

Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO and working in close partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and executive team, the Chief Financial Officer will take complete ownership of TLC Nursing’s global financial strategy, capital management, and fiscal operations.



You will serve as a key driver of enterprise growth, evaluating dynamic revenue models (travel nursing, per diem, allied health, and direct hire), optimizing multi-state payroll and billing operations, and ensuring sustainable margin expansion and long-term fiscal strength.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Financial Leadership



*Partner with the CEO, COO, and executive team to drive long-term strategic growth, multi-year forecasting, and capital deployment.

*Lead high-level financial planning and analysis (FP&A), scenario modeling, and risk management tailored to the healthcare staffing industry.

*Evaluate capital allocation strategies, banking/credit facilities, organic growth initiatives, and potential M&A or strategic partnership opportunities.



Financial Operations, Payroll & Billing Oversight



*Direct all finance functions, including accounting, corporate treasury, tax compliance, financial reporting, and audit management.

*Oversee and optimize high-volume, multi-state payroll and client billing operations specific to travel healthcare clinicians and facility partners.

*Drive unit economics performance, gross margin optimization, labor cost management, and working capital expansion.



Reporting, Compliance & Healthcare Governance



*Ensure rigorous financial compliance with state and federal healthcare staffing regulations, multi-state tax frameworks, and GAAP reporting standards.

*Direct monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting for executive leadership and external stakeholders.

*Enhance financial technology stacks, ERP integration, and real-time business intelligence dashboarding to monitor key metrics (bill-to-pay rates, clinician utilization, DSO, and facility contract profitability).



Executive Team Building & Organizational Growth



*Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing finance, accounting, and billing team.

*Promote a company-wide culture of fiscal accountability, data-informed decision-making, and alignment with TLC Nursing’s core values of compassion, integrity, and operational excellence.



Qualifications & Requirements



Healthcare/Staffing Experience: 10–15+ years of progressive financial management experience, with a proven track record as a CFO or VP of Finance within healthcare staffing, nurse travel agencies, or high-volume human capital businesses.



Track Record: Demonstrated success scaling high-growth businesses ($20M–$100M+ revenue scale), managing multi-state labor models, and expanding credit/working capital lines.

Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field required. MBA, CPA, or active financial certification strongly preferred.   



Technical Mastery: Deep experience with ERP platforms (NetSuite, Workday, QuickBooks), VMS/MSP staffing software (e.g., Bullhorn, Avionte, Fieldglass), and automated payroll systems.



Healthcare Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with travel nursing bill/pay rate dynamics, worker classification (W-2 traveler/stipend structures), and multi-state tax apportionment.



Leadership Style: Dynamic, collaborative communicator capable of bridging financial metrics with real-world healthcare staffing operations.



What We Offer

Highly competitive executive salary package with a performance-driven annual bonus structure.

HMO

Credit time off (CTO)

Birthday Leave

Bereavement Leave

Internet Reimbursement



Experience Required: Prior experience in healthcare staffing or nurse recruitment is mandatory. Only applicants with proven experience will be considered.

- Independent contractor engagement, part-time, about 20 hours per week. This is not an employment position.

- You set your own working hours within Australian and New Zealand business hours (roughly 4:00 AM to 2:00 PM Philippine time while New Zealand and south-east Australia are on daylight saving, about an hour later from April to September). New Zealand is our home market, so you'll likely book more meetings if some of your hours overlap with New Zealand mornings, which start at 4:00 AM Philippine time.

- You are welcome to keep other clients, as long as they do not sell a competing product (automated credit control, invoice reminder or accounts receivable collection software) in Australia or New Zealand.

- You use your own computer, reliable internet, headset and backup power/internet. We provide access to our CRM, calling platform and product information. You research and build your own prospect lists.



WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

- Agreed monthly minimums (outreach activity and qualified meetings), set out in the contractor agreement.

- Your own prospect research, then outbound calls and follow-up
s to business owners, finance managers, bookkeepers and accounting firms in Australia and New Zealand.

- Qualified meetings booked into our demo calendar. We give you a clear written definition of "qualified" before you start.

- Accurate notes in our CRM for every conversation and booking.

- A short weekly results summary.



PAY

- Base service fee: US$303 per month, paid monthly against your invoice.

- Commission: 15% of the subscription revenue we actually receive (excluding GST, refunds and credits) from every customer who attends a demo you booked and subscribes within 30 days of it, for that customer's first 12 paid months. No cap. Customers who sign up without a demo are not commissionable, so your job is to get the right people into a demo.

- Example: a customer on our NZ$174/month Professional plan earns you about NZ$26 every month for 12 months, about NZ$313 per customer. Ten active customers would add about NZ$261 per month on top of your base fee. These are examples only; commission depends on results.

- Paid by Wise or Payoneer within 7 days of receiving your invoice. You receive a commission statement every month.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven outbound B2B appointment-setting or SDR experience, ideally calling Australian or New Zealand businesses.

- Clear, confident spoken English and professional written English.

- Comfortable working in a CRM and calling software.

- Able to research and build your own prospect lists from LinkedIn, business directories and the web. We give you the target customer profile, not a list.

- Bonus: understanding of accounting workflows (invoicing, bank reconciliation, receivables) or experience with Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks.

- You run your own freelance practice. BIR-registered freelancers preferred.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word LEDGER so we know you read this ad.

2. Describe your B2B calling experience: which countries, what you sold, who you called, and how many meetings you typically booked per week.

3. Record a short voice clip on your phone (about 1 minute) and share any link (Google Drive, Vocaroo, Dropbox, etc.). Introduce yourself and tell us about your calling experience. Your own words are fine; no script needed.

4. Tell us your preferred working hours within the window above.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview that includes a short role-play call.

title: Commercial Construction Project Estimator

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

Who we are

GoNano manufactures NuRoof, a nano-technology treatment that extends the life of asphalt shingle roofs. We sell to certified contractors across the US and Canada, and we're now launching direct sales to homeowners in Houston, Texas. You would be one of our first phone closers on that program.

HubSpot experience

What we're not

How to apply — read carefully, we only review complete applications



Go to vocaroo.com (free, no account needed), click record, and in ONE take with no editing:

Say your full name and the word SHINGLE so we know you read this

Read the script in Part 1 of the attached audition text aloud

Answer the Part 2 objection in your own words (60 seconds max)

Tell us in 30 seconds about the biggest deal you've closed by phone

Click "Save & Share" and paste the Vocaroo link at the top of your application

Include your resume and your typical monthly close rate in your last sales role

Put SHINGLE as the first word of your application message



Applications without a recording will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will do a 15-minute live role-play call, then a paid one-week trial on real leads.



Audition text (paste below the post, or as a separate section)



Part 1 — Read this exactly as written, at a natural conversational pace:



Hi Mr. Delgado, this is [your name] calling from GoNano — you booked this call after checking your roof's health score online. Thanks for making time. So I've got your report pulled up here. Your roof is a 3,200-square-foot architectural shingle roof, about eleven years old, and it scored a 61, which puts it in the "Aging" zone. Our NuRoof treatment restores that flexibility and typically adds 5 to 7 years of life. title: Wholesale Sourcing VA - Amazon FBA UK/EU Supplier Research
description:
I run a UK-based Amazon FBA wholesale business and I'm looking for a full-time Sourcing VA. One job: find me suppliers nobody else has.



You are not doing outreach and you are not managing the pipeline - I handle all of that. Your entire focus is research: finding and qualifying UK and EU suppliers, then dropping them into my CRM (a Google Sheet I'll give you access to) with everything I need to contact them myself.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Authorised distributors, wholesalers and brand-direct relationships for brands that already sell on Amazon

- Niche, harder-to-find suppliers - the ones that take real digging

- Suppliers with genuine barriers to entry: high MOQs, trade-only access, application and approval processes, brand authorisation requirements

- Categories: health and beauty, household, grocery, baby, pet, toys, electricals, stationery, sports



WHAT I'M NOT LOOKING FOR

Anything findable in ten minutes on Google. No open-to-all dropship sites, no directories everyone already has, no "wholesale" sites that sell to the public. Low barrier to entry means every other seller is already there, which is no use to me.



WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO ALL DAY



Find them

- I'll give you my methods and source lists to start with, and I expect you to bring your own on top - if you have a way of finding suppliers that works, use it

- Typical angles: UK and EU trade show exhibitor lists, trade-only directories, brand websites' "stockists" and "where to buy" pages, Companies House, LinkedIn company and people search, EU trade portals

- Reverse-engineer brands already selling on Amazon UK to work out who distributes them here

- Check the CRM first - if it's already in there, move on



Qualify them

- Confirm they are a genuine wholesaler or authorised distributor, not a retailer or dropshipper

- Confirm they trade B2B, and check whether they allow Amazon sellers

- Find the MOQ, the minimum order value and whether there's an application process

- Judge the barrier to entry: is this one everybody already has, or is it hard to get into? Hard to get into is what I want



Get me the contact

- A named human where possible: name, job title, direct
, phone

- Buying, sales or national account managers preferred. Generic 
 as a last resort



Log them

- One clean row per supplier in the CRM: supplier name, website,
, phone, contact name and role, location, category, brands carried, MOQ, payment terms if listed, how you found them, and any notes on how hard they are to get an account with

- No duplicates, no half-filled rows



Report

- Short daily message: how many new suppliers you added and anything interesting you noticed

- Friday: a short summary of the week and where your best finds came from



TARGETS (we'll refine these together)

- 15+ genuinely new, suppliers per day

- Every row complete and logged the same day you find it

- Zero duplicates



YOU NEED

- Genuinely good at research - you enjoy digging, cross-referencing and finding the thing that isn't on page one

- Good written English for reading UK and EU trade sites and writing clear notes

- Comfortable in Google Sheets

- Organised and consistent - clean data is the whole job

- 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, with reasonable overlap with UK hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Previous Amazon FBA wholesale or online arbitrage sourcing experience

- Familiarity with Keepa, SellerAmp, Jungle Scout or similar

- Experience with EU/UK trade directories or trade show exhibitor lists

- Basic understanding of brand gating and IP restrictions on Amazon



WHAT YOU GET

- PHP 25,000/month to start, paid on time, every time

- Long-term full-time role - I want someone who grows with the business

- Training on my sourcing methods and my CRM

- Performance-based raises and bonuses for suppliers that turn into live accounts



HOW TO APPLY - read carefully, applications that skip this are deleted

Send your application with the subject line: Sourcing VA - [Your Name] - Distributor



In your message include:

1. A short paragraph on your research experience (no generic cover letters)

2. One example of a UK or EU wholesaler or distributor you found for an Amazon-selling brand, with the website, the brand(s) they carry, and one sentence on how you found them and why it isn't obvious

3. The research methods and tools you'd use to find trade-only suppliers

4. Your available hours in UK time



Tell me your favourite UK supermarket brand somewhere in the message so I know you read to the end.

title: Full-Time SEO Content Operations Manager for Melbourne-Based Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Position Overview

We're a growing Melbourne-based SEO and digital marketing agency hiring an experienced Content Operations Manager to lead our content production across 11 active client accounts.



This is not a junior coordinator role or a full-time writing role. You'll own the workflow end-to-end — keyword assignment, content briefing, writer management, quality assurance, publishing coordination, indexation, and post-publish checks. You'll lead writers, VAs, and publishers, maintain clear deadlines and quality standards, resolve day-to-day blockers, and help improve how our content operation runs.



This role requires both editorial judgement and operational execution. You need to keep work moving, maintain accurate task records and raise risks before deadlines are missed.



Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

This isn't "figure it out yourself" work — you'll have access to a world-class SEO system and SOP library, with structured workflows, templates, checklists, and QA standards for every stage of the pipeline. On top of that, you'll get:

Full-time, long-term remote work

Direct communication with the agency owner

Real day-to-day leadership responsibility across writers, VAs, and publishers

The authority to improve systems and hold the team accountable

All required tools and access provided from day one

A formal performance and pay review at 60–90 days

An ongoing quarterly performance bonus structure — details discussed with the successful candidate

A genuine path into broader SEO and operations leadership



What You'll Own



Content Planning + Briefs

Review assigned keywords, existing pages, and project requirements before production begins.

Confirm whether each task requires new content, a landing page, or an on-page SEO upgrade.

Build detailed SEO content briefs — search intent, structure, required topics, metadata, internal links, acceptance criteria.

Flag potentially misclassified work or unclear scope to the agency owner rather than changing it without approval.



Production + Team Leadership

Assign work to writers, VAs, and publishers with clear owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria.

Maintain a visible production pipeline in Asana; monitor progress and resolve or escalate blockers early.

Give direct, actionable feedback and confirm revisions are completed correctly.

Coach team members when standards aren't being met; escalate recurring performance issues.

Create accountability without micromanaging capable team members.



Editorial, SEO + Final QA

Complete CM review after the assistant’s first-pass checks.

Assess factual accuracy, search intent, clarity, structure, brief adherence and conversion goals.

Confirm correct title tags, H1s, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and CTAs.

Enforce retrieval-friendly formatting — direct answers, scannable sections, tables where they genuinely help.

Use originality and AI-detection tools as quality signals, applying human editorial judgement on top.

Rewrite small sections when necessary, without becoming the primary writer.



Publishing + Definition of Done

Prepare clear WordPress handoffs — URLs, metadata, links, schema, images, layout.

Review staging and live pages for formatting, links, mobile usability, and canonical setup.

Request indexing in Google Search Console and monitor for issues.

A deliverable is done when it's published, accessible, quality-checked, internally linked, schema-checked, submitted for indexing, and tracked.



Client Approvals + Reporting

Consolidate client feedback into one actionable revision request; prevent conflicting instructions and unnecessary cycles.

Distinguish between corrections, reasonable revisions, and requests that change approved scope — escalate scope changes before assigning more work.

Report weekly on production volume, completed work, overdue items, blockers, and quality issues.

Ensure documentation, indexing requests and post-publication checks are completed and tracked.



Our assistant supports initial QA, visual assets and documentation. Writers handle drafting and substantial rewrites; the developer handles publishing. You own coordination and final checks within the agreed approval process.



Workload

You'll manage content operations across 11 active clients, with a baseline of 4–6 deliverables per client each month (40–66 total). Work includes new service/landing pages, supporting SEO content (often ~4,000 words per client), on-page SEO upgrades, and metadata/internal-linking/schema tasks. You're responsible for pipeline and quality — you won't personally write all deliverables.



You’ll have templates, SOPs, checklists, client fact sheets, tools and onboarding support. Responsibility will expand in stages as you demonstrate accuracy, sound judgement and reliable delivery.



What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

You can independently run the 11-client content pipeline.

The asana dashboard accurately reflects status, owner, deadline, and blocker for every deliverable.

40–66 monthly deliverables move through production without anything lost or forgotten.

Final QA is consistent and catches issues before publication.

Client approvals are organised with minimal unnecessary revision cycles.

Published pages are checked, internally linked, submitted for indexing, and tracked.

You raise risks before they become missed deadlines and recommend practical system improvements.



Must-Haves

Please apply only if you have:

Excellent written and spoken English

Proven experience managing SEO content production in an agency environment

Experience leading writers, editors, VAs, or publishers

Previous professional SEO writing or editing experience — you won't write day-to-day, but you need to know what good content looks like to QA it properly

Strong knowledge of search intent and on-page SEO

Excellent editorial judgement and attention to detail

Confidence managing multiple clients, deadlines, and team members

The ability to give clear feedback and maintain accountability

Experience following structured systems while improving them

Reliable internet, a suitable full-time remote setup, and some availability overlapping Australian Eastern Time

Practical Asana experience: You must confidently manage tasks, subtasks, custom fields, stages, owners, deadlines, comments and time records. You’ll demonstrate this in a paid assessment.



Nice-to-Haves

WordPress publishing and live-page QA

Google Search Console and indexation workflows

Schema requirements and validation

Internal-linking strategy

Surfer or similar content optimisation tools

Grammarly and Originality.ai

ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI-assisted workflows

Content structured for AI retrieval and answer engines

Legal, real estate, or healthcare client experience 



Who Will Succeed in This Role

You're likely to succeed if you:

Take ownership without waiting to be chased

Communicate problems early

Can lead a remote team firmly and respectfully

Notice small errors before clients do

Understand the difference between activity and completed delivery

Protect approved scope while keeping work moving

Balance SEO requirements with reader value and conversion goals

Stay organised when many deliverables are active at once

This role won't suit someone who wants to focus mainly on writing, needs daily task-by-task supervision, or avoids difficult performance conversations.



Tools We Use

Asana, Google Drive, WordPress, Google Search Console, Surfer (or equivalent), Grammarly, Originality.ai, ChatGPT, Claude. You don't need experience with every tool if you can demonstrate mastery of the underlying workflow.

Compensation and Working Arrangement

US$12-15 per hour to start, full-time, 40 hours/week

Paid fortnightly or monthly, your preference

Quarterly performance bonus structure — details discussed with the successful candidate

Flexible schedule with agreed AEST overlap

All required tools and access provided

Long-term, permanent remote position



How to Apply

Start your application with the words BLUE MANAGER. Applications without this will not be considered.

Then complete our screening form: 
/?k=5DW57EJsxaoBV1F2IRMQ4g&d=
We will only review candidates who submit the completed form.



Hiring Process

Application and screening-form review

5-minute intro call — communication and fit

15-minute interview including a live QA exercise.

Paid practical exercise — realistic agency work, scoped to 60–90 minutes

Assessment debrief and reference checks.

A defined paid working trial before the ongoing appointment decision.



This is a permanent, full-time role. We're ready to hire as soon as we find the right person.

title: Real Estate Director of Broker Partnerships
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time | Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

Starting Compensation: $1,000/month



Position Overview



We are seeking a confident, highly organized, and relationship-focused Director of Broker Partnerships to lead and support relationships with broker owners, leadership teams, referral partners, and real estate professionals.



This role will serve as a key point of contact for leadership-level stakeholders and requires someone who can communicate confidently and professionally, build strong relationships, manage referral programs, and effectively represent the organization in client-facing conversations.



The ideal candidate has strong executive presence, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, leadership experience, and a solid understanding of the residential real estate industry and referral programs.



Key Responsibilities

- Serve as a primary point of contact for broker owners, executives, leadership teams, and referral partners.

- Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with brokerage partners and key stakeholders.

- Oversee and support referral programs, including placements, assignments, updates, and performance tracking.

- Manage ongoing communication with partners and internal teams to ensure timely follow-up and resolution of issues.

- Lead meetings and conversations with leadership and other high-level stakeholders with confidence and professionalism.

- Monitor referral program performance, identify trends, and provide data-driven recommendations.

- Track key metrics, program activity, and partner performance.

- Identify opportunities to improve referral processes, partner engagement, and overall program effectiveness.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure referral placements and partner requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

- Identify and resolve operational or relationship-related issues in a timely manner.

- Provide updates and reports to leadership regarding program performance and partner relationships.

- Help develop and implement best practices for referral programs and broker partnerships.

- Represent the organization professionally across all partner and leadership interactions.



Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Real Estate, or a related field preferred.

- At least 3yrs experience in program management, partnerships, account management, or a related leadership role.

- Strong experience communicating with executives, business owners, managers, and other senior stakeholders.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong executive presence with the confidence to lead conversations with leadership.

- Ability to communicate diplomatically and adapt communication style to different audiences.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and partner relationships.

- Familiarity with referral programs and referral-based business models.

- Understanding of the residential real estate industry.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.



Experience with the following is preferred:

- Follow Up Boss (FUB)

- eRelocation

- CRM and referral management platforms

- Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

- Zoom and other virtual communication platforms

- Reporting and data-tracking tools

- Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:

- Confident and polished when communicating with executives and business owners.

- A strong communicator who can clearly articulate ideas and expectations.

- Comfortable leading meetings and handling high-level conversations.

- Professional, diplomatic, and adaptable in different communication settings.

- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple relationships and priorities.

- Data-driven and comfortable reviewing performance metrics and reports.

- Proactive and solutions-oriented when addressing challenges.

- Experienced in building and maintaining long-term professional relationships.

- Knowledgeable about real estate operations, brokerages, and referral programs.
