title: Sales & Operations Representative
description:
# Sales & Operations Specialist



**ClearCoast Cleaning LLC | Remote | Full-Time**



## About ClearCoast Cleaning



ClearCoast Cleaning is a fast-growing, family-run cleaning company serving residential and commercial customers throughout the Seattle area.



We are looking for a **Sales & Operations Specialist** to join our team and help us grow.



This is a hands-on role with two main areas of responsibility: **sales and operations support**.



You will be responsible for generating new business through cold calling and outbound prospecting, handling inbound leads, following up with potential customers, assisting with marketing, and supporting our Operations Manager with scheduling and cleaner coordination.



We are looking for someone who is **proactive, organized, confident on the phone, coachable, and motivated by results.**



## Sales & Business Development



Sales is a major part of this position.



You will:



* Make outbound cold calls to potential residential and commercial customers

* Prospect for new commercial accounts

* Contact property managers, apartment communities, offices, schools, businesses, and other organizations

* Handle inbound leads from our marketing channels

* Respond quickly to new inquiries

* Qualify potential customers

* Gather information needed for quotes

* Follow up with open quotes

* Follow up with prospects who have not booked

* Schedule cleaning appointments, estimates, and walkthroughs

* Help convert one-time customers into recurring customers

* Reactivate previous customers and older leads

* Follow up with prospects by phone, text, and

* Maintain accurate notes and follow-up tasks in the CRM

* Identify additional sales opportunities

* Schedule qualified sales opportunities for the owner or sales team



### Cold Calling Is Required



You will regularly make outbound calls to people and businesses who may have never heard of ClearCoast Cleaning.



You should be comfortable:



* Picking up the phone

* Starting conversations with new prospects

* Asking questions

* Explaining our services

* Handling objections

* Following up

* Hearing "no" without getting discouraged

* Asking for the opportunity to earn their business



We are looking for someone who can become **confident and effective on the phone**, not someone who wants to avoid sales calls.



## Inbound Lead Management



You will help make sure every inbound opportunity is handled properly.



You will:



* Monitor incoming leads

* Respond quickly to new inquiries

* Answer calls, texts, and
s

* Qualify leads

* Collect property and service information

* Assist with quoting

* Follow up with leads who do not immediately book

* Track leads in the CRM

* Schedule appointments

* Follow up on unanswered quotes

* Help turn leads into booked customers



Speed and follow-through are extremely important.



## Commercial Prospecting



Commercial cleaning is an important growth opportunity for ClearCoast.



You will help identify and contact potential commercial customers, including:



* Property management companies

* Apartment communities

* Office buildings

* Schools

* Churches

* Medical offices

* Real estate companies

* Construction companies

* Multifamily properties

* Local businesses



You will research potential accounts, identify decision-makers, make outbound calls, send follow-ups, and help schedule walkthroughs and sales conversations.



The goal is to create **real business opportunities and revenue**, not simply make a high number of calls.



## Marketing Support



You will also assist with ClearCoast's marketing efforts.



This may include:



* Social media support

*
 campaigns

* SMS campaigns

* Customer reactivation campaigns

* Lead-generation campaigns

* Building prospect lists

* Researching potential customers

* Assisting with promotions

* Organizing marketing information

* Helping test new marketing ideas



You do not need to be a marketing expert. You should be comfortable learning and executing marketing tasks.



## Operations Support



ClearCoast already has an **Operations Manager who owns the operations department**.



Your role is to support the Operations Manager with day-to-day execution.



You will:



* Assist with scheduling cleaning jobs

* Coordinate cleaner availability

* Communicate job details and special instructions to cleaners

* Confirm cleaners before scheduled jobs

* Help coordinate schedule changes

* Assist with finding coverage when necessary

* Communicate with cleaners regarding upcoming jobs

* Communicate scheduling information to customers

* Monitor upcoming jobs

* Identify potential scheduling conflicts

* Make sure cleaners have the information they need

* Follow up with cleaners regarding job status

* Follow up on missing photos or required documentation

* Assist with cleaner onboarding

* Maintain cleaner availability information

* Assist with recruiting and communicating with potential cleaners

* Escalate operational issues to the Operations Manager



You are not expected to manage the operations department. Your job is to **help execute the processes and keep things moving.**



## Customer Communication



You will communicate with customers through phone, text,
, and our CRM.



You may help with:



* Scheduling

* Quotes

* Service questions

* Appointment changes

* Follow-ups

* General customer support



All communication should be professional, friendly, and solution-oriented.



## Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Confident speaking on the phone

* Comfortable with cold calling

* Comfortable with sales

* A strong communicator

* Organized

* Reliable

* Responsive

* Detail-oriented

* Self-motivated

* Coachable

* Comfortable multitasking

* Comfortable learning new software

* Good at solving problems

* Able to work independently

* Willing to take initiative

* Comfortable working in a fast-growing company



We especially value people who **take ownership**.



If you notice a problem, we want you to think about how to solve it rather than simply waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.



## Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Sales

* Cold calling

* SDR / BDR

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation

* Customer service

* CRM management

* Scheduling

* Operations

* Property management

* Real estate

* Home services

* Commercial sales

* Social media

*
 marketing

* SMS marketing



Cleaning industry experience is helpful but not required.



## How Performance Will Be Measured



### Sales



* Outbound calls

* Quality conversations

* Qualified leads

* Appointments booked

* Quotes followed up with

* Customers booked

* Recurring customers generated

* Commercial opportunities generated

* Revenue generated



### Operations



* Scheduling accuracy

* Cleaner communication

* Customer response times

* Follow-through

* Job coordination

* CRM accuracy

* Organization

* Ability to identify and escalate issues



### Marketing



* Completion of assigned campaigns

* Lead-generation support

* Customer reactivation

* Prospect research

* Quality of execution

* New ideas and initiative



We care about **results and execution**, not simply checking off tasks.



## Requirements



* Strong spoken and written English

* Reliable internet connection

* Professional and quiet workspace

* Computer capable of running CRM and communication software

* Comfortable making phone calls

* Comfortable with cold calling

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow processes

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Willingness to receive coaching and feedback



## Compensation



**Starting pay: $5-7 depending on experience***



Performance-based bonuses may be available based on individual performance and company growth.



Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility and compensation.



## Growth Opportunity



ClearCoast is growing quickly, and there is an opportunity for the right person to grow with the company.



As you demonstrate strong performance, you may have opportunities to take on greater responsibility in:



* Sales

* Commercial business development

* Marketing

* Customer success

* Operations

* Team leadership



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a valuable long-term member of the company.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your resume or work history

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Your sales experience

4. Your cold-calling experience

5. Your customer service or operations experience

6. Your availability

7. Your expected hourly rate

8. An example of a time you took initiative and solved a problem without being told exactly what to do



**Important: Cold calling is a core responsibility of this position. Please only apply if you are comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with potential customers and businesses.**

The Amazon Book Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies specifically focused on increasing the visibility, discoverability, ranking, traffic, and conversions of books on Amazon.



This role will manage and optimise Amazon book listings, conduct keyword and competitor research, manage Amazon advertising campaigns, track performance, and recommend new strategies to improve sales. title: B2B Lead Generation, Appointment Setting & Social Media VA
description:
Conscious Fuel is a Los Angeles-based company providing office coffee, healthy snacks, vending, micro-markets and workplace refreshment services.



We are seeking a friendly, resourceful and highly organized virtual assistant to support business development, lead generation, appointment setting and social media.



This is not strictly a cold-calling position. The right person will research qualified prospects, conduct professional B2B outreach, schedule appointments, maintain our CRM and provide basic social-media and customer-service support.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Research qualified Los Angeles-area businesses and add accurate information to our CRM.

• Identify office managers, administrative managers, facilities managers, operations managers and workplace-experience decision-makers.

• Prioritize WELL-certified, wellness-focused, creative and innovative workplaces.

• Make professional outbound B2B calls during Pacific Time business hours.

• Follow an approved call guide while sounding natural and conversational.

• Send approved follow-up
s and schedule qualified in-person appointments with a Conscious Fuel representative.

• Record every call, result, objection, follow-up date and next action in Google Sheets or our CRM.

• Provide brief progress reports.



SOCIAL-MEDIA SUPPORT



• Help create and schedule simple social-media posts.

• Repurpose Conscious Fuel service information into useful content.

• Create or edit basic Canva graphics.

• Organize approved images and content.

• Respond to basic comments or messages using approved language.

• Help promote office coffee, healthy vending, micro-markets and workplace wellness.



LIGHT CUSTOMER-SERVICE AND ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



• Respond to basic customer inquiries using approved information.

• Route pricing, equipment or service questions to a Conscious Fuel representative.

• Organize contact information, lead notes and customer records.

• Follow up on approved requests.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS



• Excellent spoken and written English.

• A clear, warm and professional speaking voice.

• B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

• Lead-generation and online-research experience.

• Experience calling businesses in the United States.

• Strong Google Sheets or CRM skills.

• Experience with Canva and social-media scheduling.

• Strong listening, gatekeeper and objection-handling skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

• Reliable internet, a quality headset and a quiet workspace.

• Availability during Pacific Time business hours.



Experience with office services, vending, coffee, food and beverage, wellness, commercial real estate or other B2B service companies is a plus.



COMPENSATION AND TRIAL



• $7 USD per hour.

• Approximately 6–8 hours for the initial paid project.

• $15 bonus for every qualified appointment that takes place.

• Paid training and practice-call time.

• Possibility of consistent weekly work based on performance.



A qualified appointment must be with a person who helps make decisions about office coffee, employee snacks, vending or workplace refreshments, has a realistic need, and agrees to a specific in-person meeting date and time.



TO APPLY, PLEASE PROVIDE



1. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction.

2. A description of your B2B cold-calling and lead-generation experience.

3. The number of calls and qualified appointments you typically complete.

4. Examples of social-media accounts, Canva graphics or content you have supported.

5. The calling system, CRM, Google Sheets and scheduling tools you have used.

6. Your internet speed and backup plan for internet or power outages.

7. Your availability during Pacific Time business hours.

8. A brief example of how you would respond if a receptionist says, “We’re not interested.”



Please begin your application with the words “Healthy Coffee” so we know you read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants may, at Conscious Fuel’s discretion, be invited to a separate paid practice and evaluation session.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Familiarity with the VA compensation claims process

Experience working with veterans or within a veteran-focused organization

Knowledge of medical records and related terminology

Strong ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism

Note: Please do not apply if you do not have work-related experience.

Empathy & Compassion

Patience & Emotional Stability

Attention to Detail & Accuracy

Organizational Skills

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

Adaptability & Flexibility

Integrity & Reliability

Team Orientation & Coachability

Regular interaction with veterans via phone,

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Outbound Power is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Operations Specialist to join our growing team.

This is a new full-time position designed to bring several important day-to-day operational responsibilities under one role. You will help keep orders moving, records accurate, refunds accounted for, and product pricing and inventory up to date.

This is an excellent role for someone who enjoys working behind the scenes, pays close attention to details, and takes ownership of making sure tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Responsibilities



Order Processing & Fulfillment

 - Process customer orders accurately and promptly

 - Submit and coordinate orders with our suppliers and brand partners

 - Monitor orders through fulfillment and shipment

 - Follow up on outstanding orders as needed

 - Identify order issues or discrepancies and work with the appropriate team member or supplier to resolve them

 - Maintain accurate order records and status information



Refund Tracking



 - Track customer and supplier refunds from initiation through completion

 - Verify that refunds have been processed correctly

 - Maintain accurate records of outstanding and completed refunds

 - Follow up on any refund discrepancies or delays



Order Cost & Payment Tracking

 - Maintain financial records for individual orders in Google Sheets

 - Record how each order was paid, such as credit card, bank transfer, or other payment methods

 - Record the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) associated with each order

 - Ensure order-related financial information is entered accurately and kept current

 - Identify and flag discrepancies for review



This position does not require traditional accounting or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.



Pricing & Inventory Management



 - Update product pricing when changes are provided by suppliers

 - Update inventory and product availability

 - Monitor supplier information for pricing and inventory changes

 - Verify that pricing and inventory information on our website is accurate

 - Help identify outdated or inconsistent product information



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:

 - Extremely organized and detail-oriented

 - Reliable, consistent, and able to follow through on responsibilities

 - Comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets

 - Able to perform repetitive, detail-sensitive work accurately

 - Proactive about identifying missing information or discrepancies

 - Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities at the same time

 - Able to work independently without needing constant supervision

 - A clear communicator who knows when to ask questions or escalate an issue

 - Comfortable learning new software, processes, and supplier systems



Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

 - Shopify

 - E-commerce order processing or fulfillment

 - Google Sheets

 - Inventory management

 - Product pricing updates

 - Working with suppliers or distributors

 - Order reconciliation or financial data entry

 - Extensive accounting experience is a plus but not required.



Schedule & Location



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available to work during Outbound Power's U.S. business hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Arizona time (MST), Monday through Friday



Candidates should have a reliable computer, dependable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet professional environment suitable for remote work.



About Outbound Power



Outbound Power is a U.S.-based e-commerce company specializing in home backup power, portable power stations, generators, solar equipment, batteries, and off-grid power solutions.



Our mission is simple: Help people take control of their power.



We're a growing company with a remote team that values reliability, personal responsibility, attention to detail, and exceptional service.



What Success Looks Like



In this role, success means that:

 - Orders are processed accurately and without unnecessary delays

 - Outstanding orders are actively monitored rather than forgotten

 - Refunds are tracked until they are completed

 - Payment methods and COGS are recorded accurately

 - Pricing and inventory remain current

 - Discrepancies are caught and addressed before they become larger problems

 - Other team members no longer need to spend time managing these routine operational responsibilities



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can become the person we trust to keep these important parts of our operation organized and running smoothly.

ed directly to

Tiffand is looking for a highly reliable, hands-on Amazon Seller Central Operations Manager to help manage and operate a growing portfolio of brands and hundreds of Amazon products.

We are looking for someone who is excellent at the day-to-day operational side of Amazon Seller Central and enjoys making sure things are done correctly, quickly, and profitably.



The right person will notice problems before being told about them, take ownership of getting them fixed, and constantly look for ways to make the account run better.



What You Will Be Responsible For



You will work directly inside our Amazon Seller Central account across multiple brands and approximately 900+ products.



Your responsibilities will include:



Monitoring Account Health, Performance Notifications, suppressed listings, inactive listings, stranded inventory, and other account issues

Opening Seller Support cases, following up consistently, escalating when necessary, and seeing problems through until they are resolved

Creating and managing FBA shipments

Coordinating inventory movement between suppliers, 3PLs, and Amazon

Creating and maintaining Seller SKUs

Submitting image changes to listing and seeing them through in a timely manner

Managing catalog updates, flat files, variations, attributes, images, and listing corrections

Monitoring Buy Box performance, pricing, and repricer behavior

Identifying products where pricing or repricing is not working correctly

Reviewing products that have unexpectedly lost the Buy Box or sales

Monitoring inventory levels, replenishment needs, stockouts, excess inventory, and incoming inventory

Helping prepare purchase orders and maintaining accurate inventory records

Working with InventoryLab and keeping product costs and related data accurate

Reviewing Amazon fees and product profitability

Identifying products that are losing money or underperforming financially

Looking for unnecessary expenses, incorrect fees, reimbursements, and other opportunities to save money

Managing reimbursements and inventory discrepancies

Reviewing Business Reports and operational data

Maintaining accurate Google Sheets and internal tracking files

Coordinating with our 3PLs and suppliers when shipments or inventory require action

Maintaining organized documentation in Google Drive and Basecamp

Assisting with Walmart Marketplace and eBay operations when needed



What This Job Is Really About



We want someone who thinks like an owner.



If you start work on Monday and nobody gives you a list of tasks, you should naturally be checking things such as:

Is Account Health clean?



Are any listings suppressed or inactive?

Is anything stranded?

Are there Seller Support cases that need follow-up?

Are we running low on important inventory?

Are shipments delayed?

Have we lost the Buy Box on products where we should be winning it?

Is the repricer behaving correctly?

Are any products selling at poor margins?

Are Amazon fees unexpectedly high?

Are there reimbursements we should be pursuing?

Are there operational problems quietly costing the company money?



We do not want someone who waits to be told what to do every hour.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Amazon US Seller Central

Strong experience working directly inside Seller Central, not simply managing a team that did the work

Strong knowledge of FBA shipments and inventory management

Experience with flat files and bulk listing updates

Experience fixing suppressed, stranded, inactive, and broken listings

Strong Seller Support case-management skills

Knowledge of Account Health and Amazon policy issues

Experience monitoring pricing and Buy Box performance

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

Ability to understand basic product-level P&L and profitability

Strong organizational skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

Experience with InventoryLab, Helium 10, Keepa, repricing software, Data Dive, RevSeller or similar Amazon tools is helpful.

Experience working for an Amazon wholesale reseller, distributor, or multi-brand seller is a major plus.



The Person We Want



Technical Amazon knowledge matters, but character matters the most.



We are looking for someone who is:



Extremely reliable

Hard-working

Fast

Detail-oriented

Honest

Humble and low-ego

Comfortable doing unglamorous operational work

Able to take feedback

Able to follow direction

Comfortable working independently

Willing to take responsibility when something goes wrong

Someone who actually cares whether the work gets finished



If you say something will be done, we expect it to get done.



We are not looking for someone who needs constant supervision or someone who disappears when work becomes difficult.

Full-Time and Exclusive



This is a full-time, long-term position with Tiffand.



If hired, Tiffand must be your primary and exclusive full-time professional commitment.



We do not allow job stacking or employees simultaneously working full-time jobs or maintaining recurring Amazon clients without written approval.



If you are currently employed, you are more than welcome to apply, but you must be prepared to transition fully to Tiffand if hired.



Schedule

You will work an agreed minimum 8-hour daily schedule Monday through Friday with substantial overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours 7am to 7pm.  Most of your hours MUST be worked during that time frame and you will have a dedicated time frame you must be working and available.

About Tiffand

We purchase inventory wholesale and sell it primarily through Amazon FBA. We handle Seller Central operations, inventory, catalog management, listings, pricing, Amazon issues, brand growth, and marketplace strategy.

Because we work with multiple brands and hundreds of products, strong operations are extremely important to our business.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to become an important part of a growing company.  To learn more about Tiffand visit 
.

 your application to:

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on disciplined execution, accurate financial tracking, and clear communication. As our operation continues to grow, we are looking for an Accounting Analyst who can help strengthen our accounting processes, improve recovery tracking, and make sure charges are properly documented and reconciled.



Role Overview

You will support the accounting side of our operation by managing carrier chargebacks, trailer fines, extra-trip recovery, charge reconciliation, and financial tracking. This role is built for someone who is highly detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers, and able to follow financial items from initial review through collection or resolution.



You will work closely with our existing accountants during training before gradually taking ownership of assigned accounting and recovery responsibilities.



If you enjoy reconciling numbers, investigating discrepancies, maintaining clean records, and making sure money owed to the company is properly tracked and recovered, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Manage carrier chargebacks from start to finish, including identifying valid charges, gathering support, issuing chargebacks, following up, and tracking them through collection or close.

• Review trailer fines, extra trips, and other charges to determine responsibility and ensure the correct party is billed or charged back.

• Reconcile accounting transactions and investigate discrepancies, mismatched charges, missing payments, or unsupported amounts.

• Review invoices, records, and supporting documents to confirm that charges and recoveries are accurate and properly supported.

• Maintain accurate chargeback, recovery, and reconciliation trackers, including open balances, aging, collection status, and follow-ups.

• Prepare weekly recovery reports and communicate directly with carriers and internal teams to resolve disputes, missing documentation, and outstanding balances.

• Use Excel and Google Sheets for detailed reconciliations, lookups, pivot tables, and financial tracking, while working independently and escalating issues when needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Carrier chargebacks, trailer fines, and extra-trip charges are accurately validated, documented, assigned, and tracked through collection or close.

• Accounting discrepancies and reconciliations are handled accurately and resolved promptly with minimal errors.

• Chargeback and recovery trackers remain accurate, current, and supported by complete documentation.

• Outstanding and aged recoveries are actively monitored, followed up on, and clearly reflected in weekly recovery reports.

• Carrier and internal accounting communication is professional and documented, with assigned responsibilities handled independently after training.



Who We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (4-year degree) required; Master’s degree preferred.

• AP, AR, collections, reconciliation, or recovery experience highly preferred; freight, logistics, or trucking accounting experience is a strong advantage.

• Comfortable handling chargebacks, reconciliations, collections, discrepancies, and supporting financial documentation.

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including reconciliations, lookups, and pivot tables.

• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and ability to investigate mismatched charges or records.

• Clear written English, organized, able to work independently after training, and able to manage multiple accounting items accurately.

• Reliable computer, primary and backup internet connection required; minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on training and direct feedback

• Defined responsibilities and measurable performance expectations

• Opportunity to gain specialized accounting experience within the U.S. freight and trucking industry

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage and asset based logistics operation

• Performance based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

• Schedule: Monday - Friday 7:30 AM - 5:30 PM Central Time

• Training schedule will require overlap with the current FMT accountant

• Zoom presence required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

• Reliable computer, primary internet connection, backup internet connection, and home office setup required



This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys working with numbers, reconciling financial records, investigating discrepancies, and making sure outstanding charges are properly recovered. If you are detail-driven, organized, comfortable taking ownership of accounting items from start to finish, and want to build experience within a fast-moving U.S. logistics operation, you’ll fit right in.

About Us



Vantage Point Agency is a growing US-based digital marketing and creative agency. We have served 50+ clients and are looking for a team of video editors not a one-time freelancer.



We want someone who wants to grow with us, improve their skills, and eventually take greater leadership within our creative team of editors.



The Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, dependable, and creative Video Editor who understands storytelling not just how to cut videos.



Our team produces approximately 80–100 pieces of quality video content every month, including:



* Reels, TikToks & YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos

* Full podcast episodes & podcast clips

* Reaction videos

* Talking-head content

* Quote/text-based videos

* Promotional & brand storytelling content



Technical Skills — REQUIRED



You must be comfortable with:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* CapCut for fast-paced and short-form editing workflows

* Professional color correction & color grading

* Editing footage captured on Sony cinematic cameras

* Working with LOG/flat footage and creating a polished final look

* 4K editing and exports

* Audio cleanup and mixing

* Captions and on-screen graphics

* B-roll and visual storytelling

* Music and sound design

* Short-form AND long-form editing

* Vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) formats

* Google Drive file organization

* 
 for video review, feedback, and approvals



Premiere Pro is our primary professional editing platform, but we also value editors who know how to use CapCut efficiently when it makes sense for short-form content and faster workflows.



We will provide access to Epidemic Sound for professional music and sound effects.



### Storytelling Matters



We don't want editors who simply cut clips and add captions. You should understand pacing, emotion, B-roll, music, hooks, sound design, and visual storytelling.



Because our clients are primarily US-based, you must also understand how to select accurate US-based B-roll and visuals. If someone is talking about Tampa, show Tampa FL. If they're talking about American football, don't show soccer.



If you don't understand a reference, research it before choosing the footage.



Quality Is Non-Negotiable



Our goal isn't simply to produce 80–100 videos.



It's to have 80–100 QUALITY pieces of content ready every month.



Before a video reaches our leadership team or a client, it should have:



* No typos

* No caption mistakes

* No obvious editing errors

* Accurate B-roll

* Professional color grading

* Clean audio

* Correct branding

* Correct formatting and exports

* Strong pacing and storytelling



Growth & Leadership



We want someone who is hungry to get better.



You should be willing to learn new editing styles, advanced Premiere Pro and CapCut techniques, AI tools, and emerging creative technology.



We don't want you doing the exact same type of editing a year from now.



As you grow, there is an opportunity to help lead our editing team, review other editors' work, maintain quality, manage deadlines, and make sure every editor knows what they are responsible for.



Video Editor → Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Team Leader



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:

* You only know basic video cuts and captions.

* You do not know how to color correct and color grade video.

* You are not comfortable editing 4K footage from Sony cinematic cameras.

* You do not understand storytelling, pacing, and how to keep viewers watching.

* You use random B-roll instead of choosing footage that matches what the person is saying.

We do not expect you to know everything. But we do expect you to learn, improve, solve problems, and become a better editor over time.



If you see something you don't know how to do, we want your mindset to be:

title: Growth-Minded Mid/Senior Python Developer
description:
Do you enjoy development and stimulating work that we approach like a game, with challenges and learning, all while doing great work with teammates who care? Let’s team up.



We believe in people. This is why we only work with clients who serve people. From firefighters, to law firms, to suppliers sending life-saving food to kids dying of malnutrition, the code you write will help make the world a better place.



Our team is made up of people who want to do the best work of their life. People who love to learn, challenge themselves, grow and have some fun along the journey. We also care about each other – we support each other in our own personal goals and vision. We are human beings before employees and we love to bring out the best in each other.



Now, ready to learn more about this opening? Buckle up.



If you work here, you’ll be:

- Challenged to do the best work of your life in a supportive environment.

- Become the best communicator you can become (this is the most important thing we do).

- Have the space to ask questions, voice your feedback and make a difference (and be yourself).

- Help expand our codebase and tools, participate in code reviews, and grow with your fellow developers.



You’ll do well in this job if you:

- Have a strong background in Python and understand HTML, CSS and Javascript enough to be dangerous.

- Enjoy working with people who actually care about what they do and will not let you be lazy or do sloppy work.

- Have an opinion and care about best practices and love learning and creating and building.

- Are familiar with common things we deal with as developers: Git, SQLAlchemy, building and engaging with APIs, linters, etc.

- Have grit and determination and are someone who will exceed no matter what gets in your way.

- Are attentive to details.

- Have 3+ years of Python development experience.



You probably shouldn’t apply if:

- You’re “just looking for extra money.”

- You like working 5 full-time jobs because all you care about is work.

- You get offended easily and take things personally.

- You are not someone with grit and determination who can persevere while being challenged to do great work.

- You get overwhelmed easily with new code, new habits, new learnings and chat messages.



The interview process:

- Since 99% of our work is done via Slack (we don’t do scheduled calls), the entire interview process will be via
. (With lots of questions, sprinkled with a few voice notes)

- You may be able to speak with a developer or two on our team to see how they like the role.



If you work here:

- You’ll get 13th month salary, Filipino holidays, unlimited time off (we don’t count sick days), a normal working day schedule (no night shifts, although an early start is preferred for time overlap) with some flexibility, a week off during the holidays in December, and the opportunity to grow and become your best self.



A little more about us:

- We’ve been in business for a decade+. Our teams are remote (mostly in the Philippines). Our longest standing team member has been with us for over 13+ years. We've had people quit smoking on our teams with our help, lose weight, learn a new instrument, speak a new language, and more. We all love what we do.



How to begin

- Your mission, should you choose to accept, is to apply via 
 code 571739. If you’re currently in a full-time role and are looking for something new, we’re open to a transition window. We actually care about your happiness.



NOTE: While we like AI, and we use it in certain circumstances, we ask that no AI be used during communication. Communication is the most important thing we do. If I don't see your natural voice from our first interaction, then you're setting an inaccurate representation of who you are and how you communicate. And when I see that change, it's going to come across as a lack of harmony in how you communicate. Also, we don't respond to candidates who don't follow instructions.

title: Senior Presentation & Graphic Designer (Figma Slides)
description:
Job title: Senior Presentation & Graphic Designer (Figma Slides)

Type of employment: Part-time

Hours per week: 20

Wage: $10–12 USD/hour, based on experience (about $870–1,040/month)



Job overview:



Hi, I'm Peter, creative director in LA.



We're a small design studio, and presentations are our favorite medium. Our decks have gone in front of Fortune 500 companies and investors alike. We've also worked with founders in AI, tech, and food and beverage, and with leadership organizations. We believe a great deck should feel like a great read, so compelling you can't help but click to the next slide.



I'm looking for a senior designer to join us. Some projects you'll own from first slide to last. On others, I will set the direction and you'll bring it to life.



What it's like to work with us:

We'd like to think we're a breath of fresh air. We're fast-paced and scrappy, chill in conversation, and obsessive about kerning. Some calls start with a deep discussion of life and the meanings and beauty we find within. Then we roll up our sleeves for the nitty-gritty: strategy, an action plan, and every last pixel.



What you'll make:

Pitch decks and client presentations in Figma Slides (the heart of the job)

One-pagers, social posts, and other marketing collateral, for clients and for Studio itself

Branding projects and brand applications

Now and then, motion work like Instagram videos built from templates, with more to come as we grow into it



Who you are:

You take initiative. When something's missing, you figure it out or improvise. You use your best judgment, because none of us ever has the full picture. You think a few steps ahead of the brief, do what it takes to get the work over the finish line, and speak up before anyone has to ask.



An honest note: if I have to follow up with you even once, we're probably not the right fit. We treat each other like adults here, with all the respect and autonomy that comes with it.



What you bring:

5+ years of design experience and a portfolio with real deck work

A sharp eye for layout, typography, and storytelling across a whole deck

Strong Figma skills (Figma Slides is a big plus), Illustrator and Photoshop

Clear written and spoken English. You'll mostly work with me, and we want to understand each other easily.

Comfort working in Slack and Trello

Bonus points for After Effects or motion experience



The details:

Part-time, 20 hours a week, at $10–12 USD/hour depending on experience

2–3 hours of overlap with my mornings (US Pacific time), lap being around 11 PM–2 AM Philippine time. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange.

We start with a paid test project, then a paid trial period. If it clicks, you can start the following week.

This role can grow into full-time, and we'd love for it to.



How to apply:

Send a link to your portfolio, and make sure it includes deck work. It's the first thing we'll open.

In a few sentences, tell us about a deck you're proud of and which part was yours.

Start your subject line with "SLIDE MASTER" so we know you made it to the end. (Getting people to the last slide is kind of our whole thing.)



Looking forward to seeing your work,

Peter

title: Video Editor & Virtual Assistant for Amazon Influencer Content
description:
Hi! I’m an Amazon Influencer and content creator looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Video Editor & Virtual Assistant to join my growing content business long-term.



I create product review and UGC-style content primarily focused on home, family, organization, educational/kids products, and everyday finds.



I’m looking for someone who can initially take ownership of video editing and gradually learn additional parts of my business so I can spend more of my time filming, working with brands, and growing the business.



This is a long-term position for the right person, starting at approximately 20-25 hours per week. I’m looking for an individual VA, not an agency.



🟢 WHAT YOU’LL DO 🟢



Your primary responsibility at first will be editing product review and UGC-style videos.



Most of my videos are conversational product reviews and do NOT require advanced or cinematic editing. Typical editing will include:



-Removing mistakes, retakes, and unnecessary pauses



-Cutting dead space while keeping the video natural



-Combining multiple clips into one smooth video



-Making clean, natural cuts



-Understanding conversational English well enough to make edits without changing the intended meaning or making speech sound unnatural



-Making basic audio adjustments when necessary



-Adding simple text when instructed



-Exporting videos using the correct settings



-Following my established editing style, brand voice, and guidelines



I currently use Descript for video editing. Previous Descript experience is a BIG plus, but it is not required. I will provide training on my specific editing process and access to the tools needed for your work.



Previous experience editing Amazon Influencer shoppable videos, product reviews, UGC, talking-head content, or similar content is strongly preferred.



🔵 RESPONSIBILITIES WILL GROW OVER TIME 🔵



I believe in gradually adding responsibilities rather than expecting someone to learn everything at once.



As you become comfortable with my workflow, I will train you on additional responsibilities such as:



-Organizing raw footage, completed videos, creative assets, and other files



-Creating simple thumbnails and graphics in Canva



-Uploading, scheduling, and publishing content



-Cross-posting content across YouTube, Pinterest, Instagram,
, and other platforms



-Maintaining Google Sheets and content trackers



-Keeping track of products, videos, links, and publishing status



-Product and content research



-Assisting with Amazon Creator Connections



-Assisting with brand communication, outreach, and follow-ups



-Helping identify and pursue paid brand partnerships



-Creating and updating SOPs as you learn my processes



-Helping improve systems and workflows as you become familiar with the business



-Other content-related administrative tasks as needed



You do NOT need previous experience with every part of the Amazon Influencer Program. I am happy to train the right person.



There will also be additional performance bonuses available for qualifying paid brand partnerships you help successfully secure after you have been trained on my outreach process.



🟡 CHATGPT & SOFTWARE 🟡



I use ChatGPT extensively throughout my business for content titles, descriptions, SEO, brand communication, research, and other parts of my workflow.



Experience using ChatGPT is required.



You do not need to know my specific processes yet, but you should already be comfortable using ChatGPT effectively, giving it clear instructions, following established prompts and workflows, and reviewing AI-generated work rather than simply copying it without checking it.



I have established business-specific ChatGPT conversations and processes that you will be given appropriate access to and trained on.



Experience with the following is helpful:



Descript — strongly preferred



ChatGPT — required



Canva



Google Drive



Google Sheets



YouTube / YouTube Studio



You do not need experience with every tool listed above.



🔴 WHO I’M LOOKING FOR 🔴



Editing ability is important, but reliability, communication, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are equally important to me.



I do NOT expect you to know everything on day one.



I’m looking for someone who:



-Has excellent written English



-Is comfortable speaking and understanding conversational English



-Understands natural English phrasing well enough to edit spoken content



-Has previous video-editing experience



-Has strong attention to detail



-Follows instructions and established brand standards carefully



-Is organized and manages time well



-Communicates clearly when there is a question or problem



-Is receptive to feedback and learns from it



-Can quickly learn new software and systems



-Takes ownership of assigned work



-Can eventually work independently without needing frequent follow-ups



-Meets deadlines consistently



-Is proactive rather than always waiting to be told the next step



-Is interested in a stable, long-term working relationship



-Has reliable internet and a computer capable of video editing



-Experience supporting content creators, influencers, affiliate marketers, e-commerce businesses, or the Amazon Influencer Program is a major plus.



🟣 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 🟣



-Starting pay: $5 USD/hour



-Approximately 20-25 hours per week, Monday–Friday



-Paid training



-Paid holidays and personal/sick leave



-13th-month pay



-Performance bonuses for qualifying paid brand partnerships secured after training



-Opportunities for increased hours, responsibilities, and compensation as the business grows



-Long-term position with flexible working hours and some overlap during U.S. business hours



-Specific scheduling, paid-time-off, holiday, payment, and bonus details will be discussed with the selected candidate before beginning.



⭐️⭐️⭐️ HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY ⭐️⭐️⭐️



Please do NOT send me a generic application. I will be looking closely at how well you follow these instructions.



Your application subject line must use this exact format:



ROSES ARE RED | [AMAZON or UGC or OTHER] | [DESCRIPT or OTHER]



For the first category:



Use AMAZON only if you have previously worked with Amazon Influencer onsite/shoppable video content.



Use UGC if you have edited UGC/product-review content but have not specifically worked with Amazon Influencer content.



Use OTHER if neither applies.



For the second category:



Use DESCRIPT if you have personally edited videos using Descript.



Use OTHER if you have not.



Example:



ROSES ARE RED | AMAZON | DESCRIPT



Then please answer the following:



1. Introduction Video



Send a link to a simple 30–60 second video introducing yourself.



Tell me a little about yourself, your VA/video-editing experience, and why you are interested in this position.



This does NOT need to be professionally edited. A simple video recorded on your phone or computer is completely fine.



2. Relevant Experience



Tell me about any experience you have editing:



Amazon Influencer/shoppable videos



UGC or product-review videos



Talking-head content



Other social media content



If you have worked with an Amazon Influencer before, please explain specifically what you handled for them.



3. Editing Portfolio



Please send links to 2–3 videos that YOU personally edited.



Product reviews, Amazon Influencer videos, UGC, or talking-head examples are preferred.



Please briefly explain what you personally did on each example.



4. Descript Experience



Have you used Descript for video editing?



If yes, tell me approximately how long you have used it and what types of projects you have edited with it.



5. ChatGPT Experience



Tell me specifically how you have used ChatGPT for work.



Please give me 2–3 examples of tasks you have personally used ChatGPT to complete.



6. Other Software



Which of the following have you used?



Descript, ChatGPT, Canva, Google Drive, Google Sheets, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, YouTube Studio, Amazon Influencer, Viral Vue, Oink for Influencers, Amazon Creator Connections



You can also list any other relevant software or platforms you are comfortable using.



7. Computer & Internet



Please provide:



Your computer processor and RAM



A screenshot showing your computer specifications



Your normal internet download AND upload speed



A screenshot of a recent internet speed test



Your backup plan if your internet or power goes out



8. Current Work & Availability



Are you currently working for any other clients or employers?



If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



Approximately how many hours per week are you currently available for this position?



What hours are you normally available to work in PHT (Philippine Time)?



9. English Use



How often do you use English in your everyday life?



Do you regularly speak English conversationally with friends, family, coworkers, or clients?



Please tell me a little about when and how often you speak English compared with other languages.



I’m specifically looking for someone who is comfortable with natural, conversational English, since you will be editing spoken English in product-review videos.



10. Paid Editing Test



If selected as a finalist, are you willing to complete a short PAID video-editing test using sample product-review footage?



Please answer all 10 questions and include all requested materials.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



Thank you! 😊 I’m looking forward to learning more about you and hopefully finding someone who can become a long-term part of my business.

title: AI Marketing Operator
description:
AI Marketing Operator



Part Time



Hawaiian South Shore is a surf retailer in Honolulu. 

We are looking for someone who thinks like a marketer, works confidently with AI and understands how the steps in a process fit together.

We already have AI skills performing automated jobs. Other workflows are nearing completion, including social media posting and new arrival workflows connecting our POS with Shopify listings. You will help us run and improve these systems, create more skills and fine tune the ones already in place.

YOUR ROLE

You will work with AI to develop ideas, give clear direction and keep marketing work on track. You should understand the customer journey from seeing an offer to clicking, buying and receiving follow up.

Start the appropriate workflows with clear instructions and the necessary information. Monitor progress, review the results and check supporting evidence. Spot check accuracy without manually repeating every automated task.

When something stalls or produces a poor result, investigate. Follow the steps, check the evidence and identify what needs attention. Resolve issues within your permissions or explain the blocker and what help is needed. If the same step fails twice, stop repeating it and reassess.

Work with the team to coordinate priorities, deadlines and approvals. Give clear progress updates, raise problems promptly and follow through until completion is verified. Obtain approval from the designated team member before sending campaigns or publishing posts.

Help us test improvements and develop new AI skills. Use marketing judgment to consider the customer, the offer, the message and the next action we want someone to take.

PAY AND SCHEDULE

Pay is $6 to $10 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated skills. We provide a 13th month bonus.

Start part time, a couple of days per week, approximately 4 to 5 hours per day. There is potential to grow into full time work.

title: Phone Verification Caller, start tomorrow Oct 7 at 9am ET (US B2B call list, grows into a long-term role)
description:
Start: tomorrow morning, October 7, at 9am US Eastern. The first batch must be finished by Thursday October 9 at noon Eastern. Apply only if you can start then.



The job: verify US business phone numbers by calling each one once during US business hours, listening, and recording what happened in a shared Google Sheet. You do not sell anything and you do not pitch. I give you a power dialer and everything else you need before you start. The first batch is about 160 numbers.



What you record for each number:

- Did someone answer? (yes / no)

- Was it the right person? You will have the person's name. If a person answers, say you are calling for that name and note whether it is them.

- If it went to voi
, does the voi
 say the person's name or the company name?

- Anything odd: a receptionist, a different company name, a disconnected tone, a wrong number.



What I provide:

- A power dialer that places the calls for you, so you spend your time listening and recording, not dialing.

- The sheet with the numbers, names and companies, and dropdowns for each answer.

- A short script for the one question you ask.



What I need from you:

- Clear spoken English and a quiet place to call from.

- Available during US business hours (9am to 5pm Eastern) on October 7, 8 and 9. The first batch takes about 2 hours with the dialer.

- Attention to detail. Every row gets filled, every time.

- Honest notes. "Did not answer" is a fine result. We are measuring, not selling.



Pay: $0.05 per number dialed and completed, meaning every column filled in for that row. Paid at the end of each batch. With the dialer most callers do 100 to 160 numbers an hour, which works out to $5 to $8 an hour. There is no hourly rate; you are paid for completed numbers.



After the first batch the role continues: a new batch most weeks, same work, same sheet, paid weekly. I am looking for one reliable people to own this long term.



To apply, reply with: (1) confirm you can start October 7 at 9am Eastern, (2) your internet speed and whether you have a headset, (3) one line about any phone work you have done before.

title: Experienced WordPress + Elementor Developer | Project-Based Ongoing Work
description:
Job Title

Experienced WordPress + Elementor Developer | Project-Based Ongoing Work



Job Description

Mandile Digital Marketing is looking for an experienced WordPress and Elementor developer for ongoing project-based client work.



This is not a beginner or training position. You should already be comfortable working inside existing WordPress websites, following established development standards, and completing Elementor updates without unnecessary hard coding.

We are looking for someone we can build a long-term working relationship with as projects come in.



Important: Hours Will Vary

This is a project-to-project position, not a guaranteed weekly schedule.

Some weeks may have 10–15 hours of work, while other weeks may have only a few hours or no work at all.

Most assignments will be given with a scope and deadline, allowing you to manage when the work is completed.

There will occasionally be times when we need to meet by video or screen share to review a project, discuss requirements, or troubleshoot something together.



You Must Be Experienced With

WordPress

Elementor and Elementor Pro

Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile development

Existing WordPress websites built by other developers

Elementor global styles, templates, headers, footers, and reusable elements

Troubleshooting WordPress and Elementor issues

Basic HTML/CSS when needed for troubleshooting

Testing your own work before submitting it



How We Build Websites

Our websites are primarily built using WordPress and Elementor.

If something can reasonably be built or edited using Elementor, we expect you to use Elementor.

Do not hard code page elements simply because that is your preferred development method.

You must also follow the existing structure of each website rather than rebuilding sections your own way.

Do not install plugins, add custom code, or make changes outside the requested scope without approval.

To show that you read this entire job posting and are not sending a generic application, put the words “Project Elementor” in the title of your response.



Communication Is Very Important

Strong written and spoken English is required.

You must be able to:

Follow detailed instructions

Ask questions when instructions are unclear

Tell us when you see a potential problem

Meet agreed-upon deadlines

Communicate if something may delay a project

Participate in occasional video or screen-sharing meetings

If something is confusing, ask before making assumptions.

We would rather answer a question than fix an incorrect update afterward.



Typical Work

Projects may include:

Building Elementor pages

Updating existing websites

Implementing client revisions

Creating new website sections

Fixing responsive/mobile layouts

Updating headers, footers, and navigation

Adding forms or website functionality

Troubleshooting Elementor issues

Website maintenance

Preparing websites for launch

Assisting with complete WordPress website builds



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:

Has several years of real WordPress experience

Has strong Elementor/Elementor Pro experience

Can work independently

Pays close attention to detail

Follows established processes

Doesn't take unnecessary shortcuts

Knows when to ask questions

Can work inside websites built by another developer

Is comfortable with variable weekly hours

Is interested in ongoing project work rather than a one-time assignment



How to Apply

Please answer the questions below. Generic applications that do not answer the questions may not be considered.



How many years have you worked with WordPress?

How many years have you worked with Elementor and Elementor Pro?

If you are asked to update an existing Elementor website and part of the instruction is unclear, what do you do before making the change?

If an existing website already uses global fonts, colors, containers, and reusable Elementor elements, how would you approach building a new section?

If a design can be completed using Elementor but you could also build it using custom HTML/CSS, which approach would you use on our websites and why?



Send 3–5 Elementor websites you personally worked on and briefly explain what you personally did on each website.

This position does not guarantee weekly hours. Some weeks may have 10–15 hours, some may have only a few hours, and occasionally there may be no work. Are you comfortable with that arrangement?



Please also include:

Your hourly rate

Your general availability

Your experience working on websites originally built by another developer

We are looking for someone reliable who can become a long-term development resource for our agency as projects come in.

title: Marketing, Creative & Operations Executive
description:

About the Role



We’re looking for someone who is creative, organised, proactive and commercially minded.

You won’t be doing the same thing every day.



One day you might be designing artwork for a client’s brand activation. The next, you could be creating an Instagram carousel, following up a corporate enquiry, researching potential clients or preparing information for an upcoming event.

 marketing and newsletters

s and respond to routine enquiries

The Person We’re Looking For

* Is highly organised and proactive

* Has strong Canva and design skills

* Has good knowledge of social media

* Has strong attention to detail

* Can manage multiple deadlines

* Is confident communicating with clients and businesses

* Is commercially minded

* Can work independently

* Learns new software and systems quickly

* Is resourceful and knows how to find solutions

* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do



What We Mean By “Proactive”



This is very important to us.



We don’t want someone who simply waits for a task list.



If you notice that:



* A client hasn’t replied

* A proposal needs following up

* An event is approaching and artwork is missing

* A supplier hasn’t responded

* Social media hasn’t been posted

* A potential corporate client hasn’t been contacted

part-time (20 hours a week), remote

title: Airport Shuttle Reservation Agent
description:
Airport Shuttle Reservation Agent — Excellent Spoken English — $4.50/Hour

Job type: Full-time, long-term

Location: Remote — Philippines

Starting pay: US$4.50 per hour

Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week per agent

Open positions: 2

About the Position

We are a Colorado-based airport shuttle company looking for dependable, friendly reservation agents to answer customer calls and make bookings in our reservation system.

Our customers are arranging transportation to and from the airport. They need someone who listens carefully, explains their options clearly, and gets the reservation details right.

Excellent spoken English and listening comprehension are our most important requirements. You do not need an American accent, but customers must be able to understand you easily, and you must be comfortable having a natural conversation in English.

This is primarily an inbound reservation and customer-service position, not a cold-calling job. We will provide training on our services, routes, fares, booking system, and company policies.

What You Will Do

- Answer incoming calls professionally, explain shuttle services, and help customers complete reservations.

- Accurately collect and confirm passenger names, contact information, travel dates, flight details, pickup and drop-off locations, passenger counts, and luggage requirements.

- Enter bookings in our reservation system, send confirmations, and handle permitted reservation changes.

- Answer questions using approved company information and refer unusual requests, service problems, or policy exceptions to a supervisor.

Accuracy matters. Never guess a price, promise an unavailable service, or make up an answer. We would rather you ask for help than give a customer incorrect information.

Who We Are Looking For

You should have clear spoken English, strong listening skills, professional phone manners, and the patience to help customers who may be tired, rushed, or unfamiliar with the area.

Previous experience in U.S. customer phone support, airport transportation, airline reservations, hotels, travel booking, or a call center is strongly preferred. You must be comfortable using online software, typing accurate information while speaking with customers, and following written procedures.

You will also need:

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a good headset with a clear microphone.

- A quiet, professional workspace without distracting background noise.

- Reliable attendance and full availability during your assigned shift. A backup internet connection and a plan for power interruptions are strongly preferred.

Schedule and Compensation

Starting compensation is US$4.50 per hour. At 40 hours per week, this equals US$180 per week, or approximately US$780 per month averaged over the year. Actual pay will be based on hours worked.

We are hiring two agents to staff approximately 80 scheduled hours per week in total.

Shifts follow Colorado/U.S. Mountain Time and may fall during evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. Weekend availability is important. Exact schedules will be agreed upon before hiring, and you must be able to follow the assigned U.S. schedule, including seasonal daylight-saving changes.

How to Apply

Use this application subject line:

Shuttle Reservations — [Your Name]

Please include:

1. Your résumé and a brief introduction. Describe your relevant phone-support or reservation experience, especially any work with U.S. customers.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording. Introduce yourself, explain your relevant experience, and describe how you would help a customer book an airport shuttle. Speak naturally rather than reading a polished script. Use your own voice—not an AI-generated recording—and, preferably, the headset and workspace you would use for this job.

3. Your availability and work setup. State the days and hours you can work, your time zone, whether you can work weekends and Philippine overnight shifts, and your internet and backup arrangements. Confirm that you accept the starting rate of US$4.50 per hour.

Shortlisted applicants will participate in a live English conversation and a brief mock reservation call.

We are looking for someone who is easy to understand, careful with details, dependable, and genuinely helpful to customers.

title: Phone Appointment Setter (Real Estate)
description:
BEFORE YOU APPLY, READ THIS



Application is BELOW, applying here will not be considered an application.



THE ROLE: 



When someone fills out a form about selling their home or getting a mortgage, the first person who calls them usually wins. Our clients are realtors and lenders. They're at showings, closings and open houses all day, so they can't call back in 5 minutes. You can.



This is a phone role. If you want a job where you answer leads "when you get to it," this isn't it. If you're quick, honest and good with people, keep reading.





Who we are



Maven X is a real estate marketing and advertising agency serving Silicon Valley, Santa Cruz, Monterey, Phoenix and Miami. We've marketed over $1B in properties and run full-funnel ad campaigns that bring top agents and lenders a steady flow of seller and buyer leads.



We don't just want to make beautiful content. We want our work to turn into real deals for our clients. That means every lead gets a fast, helpful call.



Our values: excellence, communication, ownership, growth, integrity and results.





The role



You're the person who turns our clients' leads into appointments.



A lead comes in, and you call them within minutes. You find out what they need, run the client's intake questions, handle the first objections, and book qualified leads straight onto the client's calendar. If they don't answer, you follow up. If they're months away from selling, you still book the conversation early.



You'll call for 8–10 client accounts, about 30–40 new leads a week. You'll learn each client's offer, what makes them different and the guarantee they stand behind, so you can explain it like you work for them.





How you're measured



Speed: 90%+ of new leads called within 5 minutes during your hours

Follow-up: every unreached lead gets 6+ call and text attempts in the first week

Appointments: qualified appointments booked every week. We'll set your target together after your first 30 days.

Show rate: 60%+ of your appointments actually happen

Clean CRM: every lead scored and noted before your shift ends

Client feedback: our clients never have to chase a lead







What you'll actually do



Call new leads within 5 minutes, then text if they don't answer

Qualify them and book appointments directly in GoHighLevel

Handle simple objections like "just looking," "not ready yet" or "I already have an agent"

Work follow-ups daily and older leads every week

Score and note every lead in the CRM

Learn every client's offer and tell us what you're hearing from leads







Apply if…



You have 1+ year of appointment setting, inside sales or phone-based lead follow-up

You've used GoHighLevel or another CRM

Your English is clear and natural on the phone

You're personable, honest and don't give up on harder leads

You can be online during US lead hours on a set 20-hour weekly schedule

You have reliable internet, a headset and a quiet space

Real estate or mortgage experience is a big plus







Do not apply if…



You need reminders to call your leads

You'd tell a lead whatever gets the appointment, true or not

You leave CRM notes for "later"

You get discouraged when leads don't pick up

You can't be responsive during your scheduled hours







Compensation & what you get



$600–800 USD/month base for 20 hours a week, fully remote+ Incentives for every qualified appointment that shows, so the better you are, the more you earn

Holidays off, plus performance bonuses

A brief, scripts and an objection guide for every client

Call reviews and weekly feedback, so you learn sales at a high level

More accounts and hours as we grow, and a path to managing future setters

KIKI Textiles is looking for an exceptional
 Designer for a Fashion Oriented Textile Brand, with outstanding creative and graphic design skills -we are going to be extremely selective.

We are not looking for a “good”
 designer.

Just good is not enough.

We are looking for someone with an exceptional eye, exceptional taste, fashion oriented, strong graphic design ability, and the creativity to make people stop scrolling before they even read the copy. Experience is required.



You must understand that
 design is not simply putting text, products, and buttons into a template.



It is art direction + graphic design + ecommerce psychology + conversion.



We want someone who can create compliant
s that feel like they belong to a high-fashion brand,  while still understanding exactly how to guide the customer toward clicking and purchasing.



You should have:



• Exceptional graphic design skills

• A very strong, elevated aesthetic

• High-fashion / editorial taste

• Extremely high creativity

• Excellent typography, composition, spacing, hierarchy, and visual storytelling

• Deep understanding of ecommerce
 design and conversion principles

• Experience designing promotional, editorial, product-launch, storytelling, VIP, educational, and automated-flow
s

• The ability to take a basic idea and turn it into something visually extraordinary

• Strong understanding of mobile-first
 design

• Experience working with ecommerce brands — fashion, beauty, luxury, lifestyle, or similarly visual industries strongly preferred

• A portfolio that immediately proves your level



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



You should be comfortable with professional design and ecommerce tools and understand the technical limitations of
 -  not only how to make something beautiful.



You should understand:



• Klaviyo or similar advanced ecommerce
 platforms

• Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or equivalent professional design software

• Designing specifically for desktop + mobile

• Responsive/mobile-first layouts

•
-safe typography and layout principles

• Image optimization, compression, sizing, and export for

• CTA hierarchy and conversion-focused layouts

• Designing around ecommerce customer behavior — click, scroll, product discovery, urgency, offers, launches, etc.

• Creating reusable visual systems without making every
 look like the same template

• Organizing design files, assets, versions, and final exports professionally

• Working from a creative brief while also bringing your own ideas and art direction



You should understand the difference between:



“This looks beautiful.”



and



“This looks beautiful AND it is designed to sell.”



We need both.



IMPORTANT:



If you have experience creating
s but your graphic-design skills are average, please do not apply.



If most of your
s look like standard ecommerce templates, please do not apply.



If you need someone to tell you exactly how every
 should look, please do not apply.



If your portfolio is “good,” please do not apply.



We are not trying to build good
 marketing.



We want some of the best-designed
s in ecommerce.



KIKI is a highly visual, fashion-driven fabric brand with thousands of products, constant new arrivals, incredible textures, colors, customer creations, education, founder content, trends, storytelling, and endless creative possibilities.



We need a designer capable of turning that world into
s people actually want to open, look at, click, and buy from.



HIGH GROWTH POTENTIAL



This is not a position where we want someone to simply receive tasks and execute them forever.



KIKI is growing aggressively, and we are looking for someone who can grow with the company.



For the right person, there is significant growth potential in responsibility, creative ownership, compensation, and leadership as the brand grows.



We value people who think beyond their assigned task, constantly improve their work, study what performs, bring ideas proactively, and want to become exceptional at what they do.



You need to be very hard working, responsible, organized, disciplined. Send us your portfolio and tell us in few words why we should consider you and not someone else.

Starting salary, full time, 8 hours/day- $1000. It can increase fast if the person is very good. High growth potential

title: Part-Time Executive Assistant: Email, Writing and GoHighLevel
description:
I'm Tillie, a dating coach for men. I run a small online business: 1:1 coaching, a paid online community, and a lot of short video content. I need a sharp, organized right hand.



What you'll do:

- Manage my inbox and draft replies.

- Write
s and short copy in my voice.

- Keep my tools running smoothly: GoHighLevel, Notion and ManyChat.

- Make simple graphics in Canva.

- Catch mistakes and fix small problems before they grow.

- General admin and odds and ends.



Who you are:

- Excellent written English. This matters more than anything else on this list.

- You spot problems before they happen and tell me before I ask.

- Very organized. You keep track of things so I don't have to.

- You know Notion and GoHighLevel (or a similar CRM). ManyChat and Canva are a plus.

- You use AI tools well and you check their work.



Details:

- About 3 hours a day, Wednesday to Sunday, to start (around 15 hours a week). Hours will likely grow.

- Able to work 6 days a week is a plus, but not required.

- Up to $7 USD per hour, based on experience.

- Some overlap with North American business hours.

- Long-term role with room to grow.



How to apply (I will not read applications that skip this):

1. Start your application with the words: BedTalk Assistant

2. Include a link to a 2 minute video of you talking to the camera (Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube). No script. Tell me who you are and what assistant work you have done, one task you are proud of and what made it hard, and why you want this job.

3. Answer these in your own words, 2 to 4 sentences each:

   a. Tell me about a time you caught a problem before your boss noticed it. What did you do?

   b. What have you actually built or changed in GoHighLevel? Be specific.

   c. A client
s me: "I can't find the link for today's call." Write the reply you would send.

4. Tell me which days and how many hours a day you can work, and when you could start.
