title: Senior Executive Assistant – Accounting & Operation
description:
This is not a typical virtual assistant position.



SimulEYE is a growing U.S.-based company that develops and manufactures surgical training models for the ophthalmology industry. We are looking for an exceptionally intelligent, detail-oriented and professional person to become a trusted right hand to our CEO and an important long-term member of our team.



This position combines accounting and financial administration, executive support, operations and special projects. For that reason, we are particularly interested in candidates with a strong accounting or bookkeeping background who also have the communication skills, judgment and versatility to support senior executives.



Attention to detail is the single most important quality for this position.



Our CEO is extremely detail-oriented and has very high standards for accuracy, organization and follow-through. You should be the kind of person who notices when a number doesn’t look right, catches a small error before anyone else does, double-checks your work without being asked and dislikes leaving loose ends.



We are a relatively small company, so this is a true “Swiss Army knife” role. You will not do the same five tasks every day. You may run payroll in the morning, update a cash-flow report, coordinate with our VP of Sales in Europe, research something for the CEO, reconcile expenses, arrange international travel, prepare a report and then help solve a completely unrelated problem that afternoon.



If your reaction to something you’ve never done before is “I’ll figure it out,” you may be a very good fit for us.



What you’ll be responsible for

• Payroll processing and payroll-related administration

• Bookkeeping and accounting support, including QuickBooks Online

• Weekly cash-flow reporting and financial tracking

• Expense reports, reimbursements and credit-card reconciliation

• Accounts receivable and collections follow-up

• Sales commissions, revenue projections and financial spreadsheets

• PTO and 401(k) administration

• Supporting P&L, forecasting and quarterly accounting processes

• Maintaining master files, pricing information and other company data

• Calendar, task and priority management for the CEO

• Monitoring
 and ensuring important matters receive timely follow-up

• Preparing professional correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, SOPs and presentations

• Travel coordination, including flights, hotels, ground transportation and international travel

• Meeting and event coordination

• HubSpot and CRM administration

• Research, reporting and special projects

• Coordinating with our operations, sales, accounting and leadership teams

• Identifying ways to improve processes rather than simply following them



The position will primarily support our CEO, but you will also work with and report to our Chief Strategy Officer. You will interact regularly with senior members of our company, including our Operations Manager and sales leadership in both the United States and Europe, as well as outside accountants, vendors and, occasionally, clients.



Because of this, excellent spoken and written English is essential. You must be comfortable communicating professionally with U.S. executives and senior businesspeople and representing our company well.



We are looking for someone with a strong accounting/bookkeeping foundation who is also an exceptional organizer and problem solver. Experience supporting a CEO or senior executive is valuable, but we care more about your intelligence, judgment, financial aptitude and attention to detail than whether your previous title was “Executive Assistant.”



You should have strong experience with accounting/bookkeeping and financial spreadsheets, including QuickBooks Online; excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills; strong analytical and critical-thinking ability; exceptional organization and follow-through; excellent written and spoken English; strong technology skills; discretion with confidential financial and personnel information; and the ability to work independently without requiring constant direction.



A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field is strongly preferred.



We especially value people who think beyond the task. If you see a better way to organize a process, catch a potential problem, or have an idea that could make the company operate more efficiently, we want you to speak up.



This is a full-time position working Monday through Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time. The schedule may occasionally shift approximately one hour earlier or later as business needs evolve.



We also need someone who understands the nature of supporting senior executives. Very occasionally, something genuinely time-sensitive may arise outside normal working hours, particularly when our executives are traveling internationally. We do not expect routine evening or weekend work, but we need someone dependable whom we can reach when an unusual, important situation occurs.



Starting compensation is $1,800 USD per month.



This is an independent-contractor position, and you will be responsible for your own taxes and statutory obligations in the Philippines. A background check will be required before final engagement.



We’re looking for someone who wants a home, not a stepping stone.



Although you will work remotely, we will treat you as an important member of SimulEYE. We value loyalty, integrity, hard work and people who take genuine ownership of their responsibilities. We recognize excellent performance and increased responsibility through compensation growth over time.



We hope to find someone who wants to learn our company deeply, grow as the company grows and build a long-term relationship with us.



How to apply



Attention to detail begins with the application.



Please send your application with the subject line “SimulEYE – Details Matter.”



In your application, please include:



Your résumé/CV.

A brief explanation of your accounting and bookkeeping experience, including your experience with QuickBooks Online, payroll and financial reporting.

An example of a time you caught an error or problem that other people had missed. What did you notice, and what did you do?

An example of something you were asked to accomplish that you did not initially know how to do. How did you figure it out?

A short video (approximately 60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why this particular position interests you.

Confirmation that you are able to work full-time U.S. Pacific hours.

Please follow all application instructions carefully. Applications that do not include the requested information will not be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
The Company:



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. 



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. 



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. 



Position Overview:

The SDR is a full-cycle sales role responsible for opening new doors for MPHQ — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and converting outbound conversations into qualified opportunities and closed business. You will prospect into US provider offices, navigate to decision-makers, understand their compliance needs, position the Company's value, handle objections, and close business. 



Success means consistent activity, strong conversion, disciplined pipeline management, and month-over-month quota attainment. You are a seller, not a script reader — comfortable creating conversations from cold outreach, asking strong discovery questions, listening before recommending, handling rejection, and asking for the close. 



Key Responsibilities:



Outbound Prospecting

• Make high-volume outbound calls into assigned US provider-office lists using targeted data and approved calling cadences. 

• Navigate gatekeepers and reach office managers, practice administrators, owners, and other decision-makers professionally. 

• Execute multi-touch outreach across calls and approved sales-engagement channels so viable accounts are not abandoned after a single attempt. 

• Prioritize accounts and activities based on ICP, likelihood to engage, and pipeline potential. 



Consultative Selling

• Open calls as conversations, not pitches, and earn the prospect's attention through relevant questions. 

• Understand how the practice manages compliance today, who they use, what it costs, and where the pain points are. 

• Translate compliance and waste requirements into clear, practical language for busy healthcare decision-makers. 

• Recommend solutions based on the prospect's needs and be transparent when Accordant is not the right fit. 

• Build relationships that create future opportunities even when the initial answer is no. 



Selling & Closing

• Position Accordant Capital, MedPro & MP1 Solutions around cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability based on what matters to the prospect. 

• Handle price, incumbent-vendor, timing, and other objections without unnecessarily discounting value. 

• Present promotional and incentive-based offers accurately and consistently. 

• Carry qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle to signed agreement, escalating larger or more complex deals according to the defined path. 

• Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customers, and revenue. 



Pipeline & CRM Discipline

• Respond to inbound leads quickly and qualify them against agreed criteria when assigned. 

• Keep accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, and next steps current in the CRM the same day. 

• Own and prioritize your pipeline based on likelihood to close and expected value. 

• Complete follow-up according to the defined cadence and maintain accurate opportunity stages and close dates. 



Coaching & Team Contribution

• Participate fully in team huddles, call coaching, role plays, and call reviews. 

• Apply coaching feedback immediately and demonstrate measurable improvement. 

• Share effective discovery questions, objection responses, talk tracks, and prospect insights with the team. 

• Represent Accordant Capital professionally in every customer interaction and support occasional client-facing events or networking activities as needed. 



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years in outbound B2B sales or another quota-carrying, phone-based sales role. 

• Demonstrated success with high-volume outbound cold calling and net-new account acquisition. 

• Demonstrated closing experience — not solely appointment setting or lead qualification. 

• Comfort with consultative selling: asks strong questions, listens actively, diagnoses needs, and recommends appropriately. 

• Strong spoken and written English with a warm, confident, professional phone presence for a US audience. 

• Experience using a CRM and sales-engagement or sequencing tools; Salesforce, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel experience preferred. 

• Comfort with dialers and call-recording/coaching tools such as Gong or equivalent. 

• Resilience, coachability, and ability to perform consistently in a rejection-heavy, quota-driven environment. 

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST). 



Nice-to-Have:

• Experience selling into US non-acute healthcare practices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, or similar. 

• Experience selling compliance, medical waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services. 

• Experience with Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Gong, or comparable sales technology. 

• Experience working under tiered incentive or commission plans. 

• Existing familiarity with US healthcare practice management or compliance environments. 



Compensation & Benefits:

• Base pay starts at $1000/month based on experience

• Plus potential performance incentives tied to qualified opportunities generated and new customers closed. Incentives are discretionary and may be provided, adjusted, or removed by the Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract. 

• Full-time, permanent work-from-home. 

• Monday–Friday, full overlap with US business hours (CST) to align with US provider-office calling windows. 

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Reliable remote work setup with a stable, high-speed internet connection.

• Noise-canceling headset for a professional, US-facing phone presence.

• Backup power and backup internet connection.

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home.

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST).



Application Process:

1. Record a 1–2-minute video introduction using Loom or Vocaroo and share the link with us for easy access.



In your video, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following: 

• What is your outbound sales/cold-calling experience? Please include your years of experience and the type of roles you've handled (e.g., SDR, BDR, telesales, appointment setting, full-cycle closing). 



• Have you carried and consistently met a sales quota? Briefly share the quota structure and your typical attainment. 



• How many years have you worked in a work-from-home/remote setup supporting a US-based team or US clients? 



• Are you currently employed or working under a contract? If yes, please briefly share your current work arrangement and availability. 



3. Please email the following to 

Use the following subject line: [Your Full Name] – SDR – Remote

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Senior Account Manager – Healthcare Compliance (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of mid-market B2B healthcare clients — serving as their single point of accountability, growing the relationship, and protecting long-term retention. This isn't a transactional support role: you'll build executive-level trust, run business reviews, and drive measurable growth within your book of business.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Client Partnership



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

• Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.

• Conduct recurring Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value, review performance, and align future initiatives.

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry.



2. Client Success & Experience



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.



4. Portfolio Health Management



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.



5. Cross-Functional Leadership



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations.



Required Qualifications:



• 3–5 years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Client Success, Business Development, or • Account Management. 

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of B2B clients while driving client satisfaction, retention, and account growth. 

• Demonstrated success conducting business reviews, renewal discussions, and identifying expansion opportunities. 

• Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills with multiple stakeholder levels. 

• Experience collaborating across Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Product, and Sales to deliver client outcomes. 

• Proficient in CRM systems, account planning, and customer performance analysis. 

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

• Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.



Typical Portfolio:

• A portfolio of mid-market clients — moderate to high complexity accounts requiring active relationship management

• More accounts than the enterprise tier, with a mix of steady-state relationships and growth opportunities

• Full accountability for renewals, client health, strategic account planning, and portfolio growth within this book of business



Technical Skills:



•Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar customer relationship management systems.

•Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer performance metrics, identify trends, and develop strategic recommendations.

•Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare executive presentations, account reviews, and business insights.

•Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies.

•Reliable high-speed internet, a private and secure workspace, and use of company-issued equipment and VPN for all client and system access.



Nice-to-Have (Optional):

•Background in healthcare, healthcare compliance, environmental services, medical waste management, or multi-location service organizations.

•Professional certifications in Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, Sales, or Healthcare Compliance (e.g., CCSM, PMP, Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), CHC, CHPC, or equivalent) are an advantage.

•Familiarity with healthcare regulatory and compliance standards (e.g., OSHA, HIPAA, DOT, EPA, or other healthcare/environmental compliance requirements) is preferred.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $1,000–$1,200 base salary per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home

Please ensure your resume is attached before submitting your application.

Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.



Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Oversee accurate and timely processing of all financial transactions: vendor payables, service billings, manifest entries, client invoices, and payment applications

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

• Manage the billing cycle calendar: maintain a disciplined, predictable cadence for invoice runs, payment postings, and month-end closes

• Build and enforce quality controls that reduce error rates, prevent duplicate payments, and maintain clean accounts across all transaction types

Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

title: Part-Time GHL Systems Reliability Specialist (GoHighLevel + Zapier) - 8-Week Paid Trial
description:
Grow Baby Grow builds and runs CRM and marketing systems for local service businesses. Our stack is GoHighLevel (funnels, workflows, SMS/email, pipelines, sub-accounts), Zapier, web forms, and third-party integrations.



We run an internal TAO audit process that surfaces system errors across our accounts. Our operations lead runs the audits and owns the queue - but fixes are accumulating because nobody has dedicated time to investigate and repair them. The operations team prioritizes the audit queue.



This is a SYSTEMS RELIABILITY ROLE. It is not a general VA role, and it is not primarily a new-funnel-building role. We need someone who can:

- Learn how our existing systems actually work - triggers, workflows, integrations, and the expected outcome at each step

- Take an assigned error from the audit queue, trace it to its root cause, and make a careful, minimal repair

- Prove the fix worked with real evidence - not "it should be fine now" - including scheduled follow-up checks for fixes that could silently regress

- Document everything so the next person doesn't have to re-investigate



The operations team owns the audit queue and priorities. You own investigating, documenting, repairing, and validating assigned issues.



Production changes follow GBG's approval rules: you don't independently change client-facing workflow behavior, routing, or attribution - changes like that go through approval first.



THE 8-WEEK TRIAL:

- Weeks 1-2: Learn and map one mature client system end to end - document how it's supposed to work.

- Weeks 3-8: Work prioritized repairs from the TAO audit queue.

- Longer-term hours and compensation are reviewed after the trial based on performance and GBG's capacity. We don't promise full-time work, a raise, or any future salary.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

- No unresolved critical errors; no high-priority errors sitting without an owner

- The repair backlog shrinks week over week

- Every fix ships with documentation and validation evidence

- Fixes hold - no regressions on items you've repaired (scheduled follow-up checks where silent regression is a risk)



REQUIRED:

- 2+ years hands-on GoHighLevel in live client systems (workflows, triggers, custom fields, pipelines, sub-accounts) - and real experience debugging broken automations, not just building new ones

- Working Zapier knowledge: multi-step zaps, filters, error handling, webhooks basics

- A track record of tracing a failure to its root cause before changing anything

- Clear, structured written English - your documentation is part of the deliverable

- Self-directed: comfortable working a prioritized queue with minimal hand-holding



NOT REQUIRED (won't help your application):

- GHL certifications, course completions, or agency badges - we score troubleshooting ability, not credentials

- Funnel-building portfolios - this role repairs systems; it doesn't build new ones



HOURS, PAY, SCHEDULE:

- $7-10/hour, starting at 20 hours/week for the eight-week trial. State your expected rate in the application.

- Agreed overlap windows during US Eastern business hours, plus a regular check-in call with our operations lead - exact windows are set together when we agree on the schedule.



HOW TO APPLY:

Short application form (about 10 minutes, no unpaid test):





Shortlisted candidates are invited to a 30-minute video call. No homework or unpaid work at any stage.

title: Website Designer
description:
Hi! I’m looking for a creative web designer/developer to help redesign the website for my creative business, NOW Studios.

I already have a very specific visual direction and reference/mockup for the website. I am NOT looking for a traditional modern/minimal website.

The concept is a late-90s/early-2000s Y2K computer/Internet website, inspired by Windows 98/2000, old Internet Explorer websites, desktop icons, pop-up windows, .EXE programs, visitor counters, chatrooms, chrome graphics, CDs, camcorders, old digital cameras, etc.

The main color palette should be chrome/silver, black, white, Windows/electric blue, and small green digital accents. I do NOT want the website overly pink or overly feminine.

The website is for NOW Studios, a DMV creative studio offering photography, podcast recording, studio rental and content production. We also have two original entertainment platforms that operate from the studio: Big Cypher Couch and Spill It.

I currently use Pixieset and would ideally like to keep Pixieset for my booking/client gallery functions. I need someone who can determine the best way to create the custom Y2K front-end experience while allowing my Pixieset booking pages/galleries to remain integrated or linked.

The homepage concept includes:

- A Windows-style vertical desktop menu on the left

- NOW Studios chrome logo

- NOWSTUDIOS.EXE main window

- Old Windows/Internet Explorer-style pop-up boxes

- "Book A Session" and "Explore The Studio" buttons

- Photography, Podcast and Studio Rental sections

- Big Cypher Couch and Spill It sections under "NOW Originals"

- Fake Y2K chatroom/guestbook

- Scrolling marquee text

- ONLINE status indicator

- Old-school visitor counter

- Chrome/Y2K graphics

- CDs, camcorders, cameras, cursors, sparkles and computer icons

- Interactive hover/click effects

- Responsive mobile version

Most importantly: I already have a visual mockup showing exactly what I want. I don't need someone to reinvent the concept—I need someone who can take the reference and turn it into a polished, functional website.

The site should look authentically Y2K, but it still needs to function professionally in 2026.

Please send me:

1. Examples of websites you've designed/developed.

2. Whether you're comfortable with HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

3. Whether you've worked with Pixieset or embedded/custom website code before.

4. Whether you can make the website responsive for desktop and mobile.

5. Your estimated price for the project.

6. Estimated turnaround time.

Please do not apply if you only work with premade templates. I'm specifically looking for someone comfortable creating a custom visual experience.

I will provide the NOW Studios logo, brand assets, photos, website copy, page links and visual references.

Thank you!

This is a real growth path - the person who masters this seat ends up owning the function.

title: Part-Time Behavioral Health Billing Specialist (SimplePractice, Lyra/Modern Health, Availity)
description:
A California-based telehealth psychology practice is looking for an experienced medical billing specialist to own billing from session to payment. This is a focused specialist role, covering billing and the records work that supports it, with real autonomy, a clear path to higher pay, and a practice owner who values accuracy and initiative.

Why this role

•	Focused work. Billing and records only, with no marketing, social media or general admin.

•	Flexible and mostly asynchronous. You set your working hours. After training, check-ins happen only when needed.

•	Clear pay growth. A starting rate of $4.50–$5.50 USD per hour based on experience, a raise back-paid to day one once you pass a 30-day trial, another at 6 months, and quarterly bonus opportunities.

•	Rewards efficiency. You are paid for the work you complete, so accurate, efficient people do well here.

Your responsibilities

1.	Pre-billing check: before each claim or invoice goes out, confirm in SimplePractice that Note Taker output is saved to the session note, the required documentation is complete and signed, and client billing details, insurance information and authorizations are current. This is a completeness check only. You will not read or edit clinical note content.

2.	Benefits and session tracking: track each client's covered sessions, including EAP session limits in Lyra Health and similar platforms, authorizations and their expiration dates, and insurance changes. Flag clients before they run out, for example when 2 sessions remain, and note the next step needed.

3.	Follow-up list: keep a running spreadsheet, updated at least weekly, of anything that needs action before a session can be billed or continue to be covered, including items for the clinician to check or sign, clients near their benefit limits, and actions clients need to take.

4.	Client billing messages: send billing-related messages from the practice's admin
 using approved templates (benefits running out, insurance updates, balances due, superbills, missing paperwork). Anything outside a template, or any reply about something other than billing, goes to the clinician the same day.

5.	Billing: submit and manage billing in SimplePractice for insurance and self-pay clients.

6.	EAP billing and reconciliation: bill EAP sessions (Lyra Health and similar platforms) through each platform's own provider portal and follow them through to payment. EAP eligibility, session counts and claims don't update in SimplePractice, so you'll regularly reconcile each portal against SimplePractice and correct any mismatch.

7.	Claim follow-up: use Availity to check claim status, find out why claims were denied or are stuck, and resolve them.

8.	Payments and account reconciliation: post payments, reconcile every client account so each payment matches its session, track client balances, and send superbills and statements.

9.	Data entry and proactive support: keep billing and practice records accurate and current. When you spot a problem, such as recurring denials, paperwork that's often missing, records that are out of date, or a step that could be faster, fix it or flag it.

10.	Weekly output report (Fridays): one report in the shared folder, using the standard template: work completed (sessions checked and billed, EAP portals reconciled, payments posted, claims followed up, messages sent), results (outstanding balances by age, denials and their status, open follow-up items), improvements made or suggested, hours by task, and next week’s plan. Totals and client initials or IDs only.

Practice volume

•	Sessions billed per week: typically 15 to 44, depending on caseload and the time of year. That includes room for up to 20% growth.

•	Scheduled sessions: an average of 25 per week.

•	Holiday and time-off dips: volume drops in late July, late November, and late December through early January.

•	Practice closures (no billable sessions): January 1, July 4, December 24, December 25 and December 26. Any session recorded on one of these dates needs to be checked and corrected.

Required experience

Core skills: medical billing, electronic health record (EHR) systems, and account reconciliation.

At least 1 year of full-time-equivalent experience in each of the following (about 40 hours a week; part-time counts proportionally, so 20 hours a week for 2 years equals 1 year):

•	Medical billing in a mental health electronic health record (EHR), such as SimplePractice or a similar system

•	Lyra Health or Modern Health provider billing, including reconciling the EAP portal against the EHR

•	Availity, for claim status and research

You also bring:

•	Clear spoken and written English, comfortable discussing billing issues by phone or video

•	Proficiency in Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Drive, Sheets and Docs

•	Experience preparing superbills and tracking EAP or authorization session limits

•	Denial follow-up experience in US healthcare billing

•	Fast, accurate data entry

Preferred

•	SimplePractice experience

•	Experience catching up a billing backlog

•	HIPAA training certificate

How success is measured

We keep management light by agreeing on a few clear measures up front. Your weekly output report covers them:

•	Billing speed: sessions billed within 2 business days.

•	Accuracy: no billing errors caused by you.

•	Follow-up: denied and unpaid claims followed up within 5 business days.

•	Aging balances: balances older than 30 days trending down.

•	Reporting: weekly output report complete and on time.

What you d
 on your own

•	Handle independently: correcting data errors, resending statements and superbills, following up on claims and denials, sending template billing messages, reconciling EAP portals, and updating the follow-up list.

•	Same day to the practice owner: only personal or clinical messages.

•	Note in your weekly report: requests for refunds, write-offs or fee changes, client complaints (after a calm, templated reply), and anything outside a template. Nothing involving money back to a client happens without written approval.

•	Own the playbook: you will build and keep up short written procedures for each recurring task, so the work stays consistent and easy to hand off.

How we work

•	Hours: about 6–12 hours a week, varying with caseload, and toward the higher end at first during training and while we clear the backlog.

•	Rhythm: work at least 3 days a week and bill sessions within 2 business days of when they happen.

•	Training (first 6 months): work up to 3 hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10 am and 3 pm Pacific Time (overnight on Wednesdays and Fridays in the Philippines), so questions can be answered in real time. This is part of your regular hours, not extra time.

•	After training: a short check-in only when needed. Everything else runs through the shared folder and your weekly report.

•	Productive hours: you're paid for time spent working. When the queue is clear, let us know, and there's no need to fill time. Your weekly output report shows the work behind your hours.

•	Quality: correcting your own errors is part of the job and is not billed separately.

Security and confidentiality

•	Sign a HIPAA business associate agreement and a confidentiality agreement before getting access.

•	Use your own logins with two-factor sign-in, and work only inside the practice’s systems, with no downloading of client files.

•	Keep client-related records, including the follow-up list, only in practice-approved systems, using client initials or ID numbers.

•	Use the admin
 only for billing communication, using the approved templates.

•	Work on your own secure, password-protected computer and a private internet connection, never public or shared Wi-Fi.

Pay and growth

•	Starting rate: $4.50–$5.50 USD per hour, based on experience, during the 30-day trial.

•	+$0.50 per hour, back-paid to your first day, once you pass the 30-day trial by billing every session within 2 business days, avoiding billing errors, and sending a complete weekly output report.

•	+$0.50 per hour more at 6 months, when training ends, once the backlog is cleared, denied and unpaid claims are followed up within 5 business days, you work independently, and you have put at least one process improvement in place.

•	Quarterly bonuses: each quarter is a fresh opportunity to earn a bonus based on that quarter's performance. At full performance, bonuses are worth up to about $1 per hour on top of your rate, which also helps keep income steady through holiday and closure periods. Details will be discussed when you're hired.

•	Looking ahead: after 6 months, the role may move to a fixed monthly rate for the defined scope of work. Rates are reviewed yearly.

•	Payment: paid every two weeks.

To apply

Put "SimplePractice Billing Specialist" in the subject line and answer the following:

1.	Name the mental health EHR(s) you have billed in. For each EHR, plus Lyra Health or Modern Health and Availity, list how many years you used it, your average hours per week, and what you did in it.

2.	A claim comes back denied. What's the first thing you check, and why?

3.	Before you bill a session, what do you check to confirm it's ready to bill?

4.	How do you keep data entry both fast and accurate?

5.	For the first 6 months, can you reliably work up to 3 hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10 am and 3 pm Pacific Time? What hours would that be in your time zone?

6.	Describe a time you found and fixed a problem in a billing or records process before anyone asked you to.

7.	You've finished all assigned tasks with 2 hours left in your week. What do you do?

8.	What hourly rate are you seeking?

Please answer all eight questions. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid practice task using sample data.

title: Outbound Caller / Appointment Setter (Part-Time, US Hours) – Real Estate Photo & Video Company
description:
⚠️ READ FIRST: Applications without a short video will not be reviewed. Instructions are at the bottom.



About us

Charlotte Real Estate Media (CREM) is a fast-growing real estate photography and video company in Charlotte, North Carolina, USA. We've shot 2,000+ listings and worked with 550+ real estate agents. We deliver photos, video, drone and 3D tours the very next day.



The role

You'll call real estate agents in the Charlotte area, introduce our company, and book them for a photo/video shoot. You won't be guessing who to call: our system gives you a ready list every day, dials for you, shows you exactly what to say, and records results. Your job is to bring the energy and start great conversations.



• About 50 calls per day

• 4 hours a day, 5 days a week (Monday–Friday)

• Shift: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM US Eastern Time (9:00 PM – 1:00 AM Philippine time)

• Calls are made from your computer (web browser), no phone needed

• Long-term, part-time contractor role



Who we're looking for

• Excellent spoken and written English: strong grammar, natural flow, and easy to understand on the first try by American listeners. A clear, neutral accent is important for this role, since agents d
 in the first 5 seconds whether to keep listening.

• High energy, friendly and fun. You smile while you talk and people can hear it.

• Confident, not shy. You enjoy talking to new people and you're comfortable hearing "no" and moving on with a positive attitude.

• Reliable: you show up on time for every shift.

• Cold calling, appointment setting or sales experience is a big plus (US clients preferred).



What you need

• A computer with Google Chrome

• A USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone (no laptop mic or Bluetooth earbuds)

• Stable internet: at least 10 Mbps upload, preferably wired, plus a backup (mobile hotspot)

• A quiet room to work from during your shift



Pay

• $7 USD per hour (20 hours/week ≈ $140/week)

• PLUS commission: 5% of every paid shoot you book (average shoot price is $600)

• Paid via Wise



How the commission works

When you book a real estate agent who has never worked with us before, that agent becomes "yours" for 90 days. You earn 5% of the full price of every paid shoot they book with us during those 90 days, not just the first one.



Example: you book an agent for a $600 shoot, and you earn $30. If that agent books 4 shoots in the next 90 days, you earn about $120 from that one agent. Commission is earned once the agent pays for the shoot. (Free promotional shoots don't earn commission.)



How to apply (required)

1. Record a 60–90 second video of yourself (face on camera, using your headset if you have one):

   • Introduce yourself and tell us about any calling or sales experience

   • Then read this out loud, like you're on a real call:

     "Hi Jessica, this is [your name] with Charlotte Real Estate Media! I saw your new listing on Oak Street, congrats! We help agents get listings sold faster with photos, video and drone, delivered the next day. Do you have a quick minute?"



2. Upload it to YouTube (unlisted), Google Drive or Loom, and make sure the link is viewable.



3. In your application, include:

   • Your video link

   • Your internet speed test screenshot (speedtest.net)

   • Your headset brand/model (or "don't have one yet")

   • The word "SPARKLE" at the top of your message, so we know you read the whole post



Again: applications without a video will not be reviewed. We're excited to meet you!

Requirements

Long-term stability for consistently strong performers

title: SALES MANAGER – CREDIT REPAIR & FUNDING COMPANY
description:
SALES MANAGER – CREDIT REPAIR & FUNDING COMPANY (Full-Time, Long-Term)



PYNK LUXURY LLC is a growing US credit repair and funding company preparing for a major launch. I'm hiring an experienced Sales Manager to run consultations, enroll new clients, and build a sales process that can grow into a full sales team.



This role is for someone who can close with confidence and integrity. Our clients come to us stressed about their credit, and they need someone who listens, explains clearly, and helps them make the right decision. If you rely on pressure tactics or promises you can't keep, do not apply.





ROLE OVERVIEW



You will own the sales process from booked consultation to enrolled client. You'll run consultations, follow up with leads, track results, and create the scripts and SOPs that future sales hires will follow. You report to the Operations Manager.





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of sales experience with US clients, with proven closing results

- Experience selling credit repair, funding, or financial services

- Ability to explain credit repair clearly: how disputes work, realistic timelines, and what clients can expect

- Strong phone and video call presence

- Experience following up with leads consistently and professionally

- Experience using a CRM to track leads and pipeline (GoHighLevel preferred)

- Fluent, professional spoken and written English with clear communication

- Highly organized and self-motivated

- Quiet work environment, quality headset, and stable internet with backup power and internet





PREFERRED (A STRONG PLUS)



- Experience leading or training a sales team

- Experience selling to clients preparing for car, apartment, or home approvals

- Experience selling business funding services

- Experience with DisputeFox





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run consultations with booked leads by phone or video

- Review each prospect's goals and situation, and recommend the right service

- Explain our services, pricing, timelines, and client agreement clearly and accurately

- Follow up with leads who don't enroll right away

- Hand new clients off to the client success team for onboarding

- Keep the CRM pipeline updated after every call

- Track and report weekly KPIs: calls booked, show rate, close rate, and revenue

- Build and improve the sales script, objection handling guide, and sales SOPs

- Help train future sales team members





COMPLIANCE (REQUIRED)



- Follow our approved sales script and payment process at all times

- Never promise or guarantee deletions, score increases, or approvals

- Never tell clients to dispute accurate information as inaccurate, or suggest CPNs or new identities

- Make sure every client receives all required disclosures and understands their cancellation rights

- Never collect payment outside our approved process





COMMUNICATION STANDARDS (REQUIRED)



- Shift: 5 days a week, [9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST]. Evening and weekend availability is a plus, since many leads book after work.

- Urgent messages answered within 30 minutes during your shift

- All other messages answered within 2 hours during your shift

- If you'll be away for more than 30 minutes, notify your manager in advance

- This is an exclusive full-time role. No other jobs or clients during your shift.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



- Every booked lead gets a consultation and timely follow-up

- Close rate and revenue are tracked and reported weekly

- A complete sales script and objection handling guide are in place

- New clients are handed off smoothly with no confusion about services or pricing

- The owner no longer takes sales calls





CONFIDENTIALITY



You'll have access to prospect and client information. You must sign a confidentiality agreement, follow our data security procedures, and work on a secure, password-protected device that is not shared with anyone.





WHAT WE OFFER



- Commission on enrolled clients 

- Long-term role with the opportunity to lead a sales team





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU:



- Love helping people and closing deals

- Can handle objections calmly and confidently

- Follow up without being pushy

- Track your numbers and always want to improve them

- Treat the business like it's your own





DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You don't have proven sales results

- You use pressure tactics or make promises to close deals

- You struggle with consistent follow-up or communication

- You need micromanagement

- You are working other jobs during the shift hours listed above





HOW TO APPLY



Applications that don't follow every step will not be reviewed.



1. Use the subject line "PYNK SALES."

2. Describe your sales experience: what you sold, who you sold to, and your average close rate.

3. Share your best sales month: how many deals you closed and the revenue you generated.

4. Include your expected base pay and earliest start date.

5. Include a 2–3 minute video (Loom or similar) showing how you'd respond to a prospect who says: "I need to think about it. Can you guarantee my score will go up?"

title: Shopify Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized developer to own the technical side of our Shopify website. If something affects how the website runs, it is your responsibility to investigate it, fix it, or coordinate the right solution.

This is a hands-on role. We regularly update product detail pages (PDPs), build landing pages, launch campaigns, and add or change Shopify apps. You should be comfortable making changes to a live ecommerce site, troubleshooting problems quickly, and keeping the website reliable.

Main responsibilities

- Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve our Shopify website.

- Build and update PDPs, landing pages, and other storefront pages.

- Implement designs and creative assets provided by our team.

- Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Shopify apps.

- Manage domain settings, DNS records, redirects, and related website issues.

- Develop or maintain PHP-based tools and integrations where needed.

- Troubleshoot issues involving checkout, forms, tracking, page functionality, and third-party integrations.

- Identify and fix broken pages, app conflicts, performance problems, and mobile display issues.

- Test changes before and after they go live.

- Keep clear records of important site settings, integrations, and changes.

- Provide regular updates and promptly flag issues that could affect customers or sales.

Requirements

- At least three years of relevant web development or ecommerce development experience.

- Strong hands-on Shopify experience, including Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Practical PHP development experience.

- Experience managing domains, DNS, redirects, and website configuration.

- Experience working with Shopify apps and third-party integrations.

- Ability to diagnose problems independently and follow them through to resolution.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication.

- Ability to manage regular page updates alongside urgent technical issues.

Preferred experience

- Building and improving ecommerce landing pages and PDPs.

- Shopify theme development and customization.

- Site speed and mobile performance improvements.

- Analytics, pixels, and conversion tracking.

- Marketing or conversion rate optimization experience. Marketing knowledge is a plus, but this is a technical role.

What success looks like

- The website works reliably, and technical issues are resolved quickly.

- PDP and landing page updates are completed accurately and on time.

- Shopify apps and integrations work as intended.

- Domain and DNS settings are maintained correctly.

- Site changes are tested, documented, and communicated clearly.

- You take ownership of the entire technical website experience without needing constant supervision.

How to apply

Please include:

1. Your résumé.

2. Links to Shopify websites you have worked on and a description of your contribution.

3. A brief summary of your PHP, domain, and DNS experience.

4. An example of a difficult website issue you diagnosed and resolved.

5. Your availability in US Eastern Time.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. The words “Technical Shopify Guy” in your application subject line.

title: Upfluence Influencer Manager and Specialist
description:
# Upfluence Influencer Marketing Manager & Specialist



We are looking for an experienced **Influencer Marketing Manager / Upfluence Specialist** to manage and grow our influencer and affiliate marketing program.



The ideal candidate has **hands-on experience with Upfluence** and understands how to identify the right creators, conduct outreach, negotiate partnerships, manage campaigns, track performance, and turn influencer relationships into measurable sales.



This is not simply a social media management position. We are looking for someone who understands **performance-driven influencer marketing** and can take ownership of the program from creator discovery through reporting and optimization.



## Responsibilities



- Manage our influencer marketing program inside **Upfluence**

- Research, identify, and qualify influencers who align with our brands and target customers

- Build targeted influencer lists based on audience demographics, engagement, niche, reach, and performance potential

- Create and manage influencer outreach campaigns

- Communicate with influencers and negotiate collaborations, rates, gifting, commissions, and deliverables

- Recruit influencers into affiliate and ambassador programs

- Coordinate product seeding and gifting campaigns

- Manage influencer relationships and follow-ups

- Develop campaign briefs and communicate content requirements

- Track content submissions, posting deadlines, promo codes, affiliate links, and campaign deliverables

- Monitor influencer-generated sales, conversions, engagement, CAC/ROAS, and other relevant KPIs

- Identify top-performing influencers and develop longer-term partnerships with them

- Test different creator segments, offers, commissions, and outreach strategies

- Maintain an organized influencer pipeline within Upfluence

- Provide regular reports showing outreach, responses, partnerships, content, revenue, and campaign performance



## Requirements



- **Proven experience using Upfluence**

- Previous experience managing influencer or creator campaigns

- Strong understanding of influencer discovery, outreach, negotiation, and campaign management

- Experience with affiliate and performance-based influencer programs

- Ability to evaluate influencer quality beyond follower count

- Understanding of engagement rates, audience demographics, conversion tracking, affiliate links, promo codes, and ROI

- Excellent written communication and relationship-management skills

- Highly organized and capable of managing many creator conversations simultaneously

- Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of results

- E-commerce or consumer-product experience is strongly preferred



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who can do more than operate the Upfluence software. We are looking for a person who understands **how to build an influencer program that generates revenue**.



You should be comfortable testing different approaches, analyzing results, identifying what is working, and continuously improving the program.



The right person will ultimately help us build a repeatable system for:



**Creator Discovery → Outreach → Partnership → Content → Sales → Retention**



## When Applying



Please include:



1. Your experience specifically with **Upfluence**

2. Examples of influencer campaigns you have managed

3. Approximate number of influencers/creators you have managed or contacted

4. Industries or product categories you have worked with

5. Your experience with affiliate or commission-based influencer programs

6. Examples of measurable results you have generated, if available

7. A brief explanation of how you would approach building an influencer program for a growing consumer brand



**Bonus:** Include screenshots or examples of Upfluence campaigns, reporting dashboards, or influencer programs you have managed, with confidential information removed.



We are looking for someone who can become a key part of our influencer marketing strategy and help us build a scalable creator acquisition channel.

title: Xactimate Estimator – U.S. Property Insurance Claims (Full-Time, Work From Home)
description:
JOB TITLE: Xactimate Estimator – U.S. Property Insurance Claims (Full-Time, Work From Home)



TYPE OF WORK: Full-time (40 hrs/week)

SALARY: ₱60,000 – ₱90,000/month, based on experience and test results, with raises as you grow

HOURS: Flexible. Must overlap at least 2 hours with U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday (example: 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM PH time)



ABOUT US

AdjustFair Public Adjusters is a licensed public adjusting firm in Michigan, USA. We represent homeowners and businesses – not insurance companies – after fires, floods and other major property losses. Our claims range from mid-size residential losses to large residential and commercial claims. You'll work closely with our field adjusters, turning their inspections into complete, accurate estimates.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Write Xactimate repair estimates for our claims, working with a steady and growing volume of work

• Work from DocuSketch 360° scans and sketches, photos, measurements and our adjusters' scope notes

• Write full-scope fire, smoke, water and wind estimates, including mitigation, demolition, rebuild and code-related items

• Revise estimates based on adjuster feedback and prepare supplements as claims develop

• Compare insurance company estimates line by line and identify missing or underpaid items

• Flag questions instead of guessing

• Follow our estimate standards, templates and Michigan price lists



REQUIREMENTS

• 3+ years writing Xactimate estimates for U.S. property insurance claims (required)

• Strong Xactimate Sketch skills, including importing sketches from 360° capture tools

• Solid knowledge of U.S. residential construction, line items, quantities and repair sequencing

• Coachable: we'll train you on our standards, and we expect you to apply feedback and keep improving

• Excellent written English

• Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan

• Able to keep client information strictly confidential (NDA required)



STRONGLY PREFERRED

• Large-loss experience (individual estimates of $100,000+)

• Experience with DocuSketch

• Commercial building estimates

• Experience working for policyholders, public adjusters or contractors (not only carrier-side desk review)

• Xactimate certification (Level 2 or 3)



WE PROVIDE

• Your Xactimate license (company-owned)

• Company
 and Google Workspace accounts

• Training on our estimate standards and the policyholder side of claims



HIRING PROCESS

1. Apply with the details below

2. Short video interview (20 minutes)

3. Paid test: write an estimate from a real (anonymized) claim file with a DocuSketch scan. Paid whether or not you are hired

4. 30-day trial period, then long-term full-time role



WHY WORK WITH US

• Long-term, stable full-time position with a growing company

• Paid weekly via Wise

• Raises based on accuracy and performance, and room to grow into a lead or commercial estimator role

• Help families and business owners recover what they're owed after a disaster



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "SCOPE" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. Years of Xactimate experience, and who you wrote estimates for (carrier, TPA, contractor, public adjuster)

2. The largest estimate you've written: type of loss and approximate dollar amount

3. How many estimates you typically completed per month

4. Experience with DocuSketch or other 360° capture tools

5. 2–3 redacted sample estimates or sketches (remove all names and addresses)

6. Your internet speed (screenshot of a speed test)

7. Your expected monthly salary

8. Answer this: "A kitchen fire caused heavy smoke damage throughout a two-story home. List 10 line items an insurance company's estimate commonly misses."

Short-form video ads - roughly 10 to 15 seconds, vertical, built from AI generation and our own 3D product renders. Meta is where we're starting, but these will run anywhere short-form video lives.



These have to read like million-dollar ads. That's the bar, and it's not negotiable. Our brand is dark, dramatic, and larger-than-life - ethereal and cinematic, not a model smiling in a sunlit kitchen. Extreme macro. Dramatic off-angles. Shallow depth of field. Constant motion. Objects floating rather than sitting on a table. Nothing static, nothing level, nothing that looks like every other jewelry ad you've scrolled past.



If it looks amateur, or if it looks like AI, it doesn't ship. We would rather publish nothing than publish something mediocre.



WHAT ACTUALLY MATTERS FOR THIS ROLE



Your creative eye comes first. Technical tool knowledge comes second.



We can teach anyone which buttons to press. We can't teach taste. We're looking for someone who understands composition, light, pacing, and tension - who knows why a shot holds attention and why the next one loses it. If your background is in editing, cinematography, motion design, or film and you've since moved into AI tools, that's exactly the profile.



Sound is half the ad. Music, sound design, the hit on a cut, the texture under a slow push - these are not an afterthought we'll add later. If you treat audio as part of the craft, say so and show us.



THE HARD PART - READ THIS CLOSELY



We want to be upfront about the real challenge, because it's where our own attempts hit a wall.



Moving a camera around a specific real piece of jewelry without the model inventing geometry. We have exact renders of our rings. The ring in the finished video has to be that ring - same setting, same stone count, same proportions - through the entire shot. The moment the model starts filling in gaps, prongs multiply, the band warps, and the piece becomes something we don't actually sell.



If you've solved this before, tell us how. That's the skill we're hiring for.



WHAT YOU'D WORK WITH



- Higgsfield (company account, credits provided) - Seedance 2.5 and the other models on the platform

- Krea for upscaling

- Our library of 3D product renders and reference imagery

- A written production brief with brand direction, shot language, and references



Experience with Runway, Veo 3, Flow, Genjutsu, OpenArt or similar all counts. We care about the result, not which tool got you there.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A reel that doesn't look AI-generated. Your work is the application.

- A real creative eye. You can explain why a shot works, not just that it looks cool.

- Ideally: luxury goods experience. If you've made marketing video for jewelry, watches, or another high-end product category, that's a significant advantage. Luxury has its own visual grammar and you either have it or you're learning it on our dime.

- Sound design instincts. Music choice, audio texture, cut timing.

- Cost discipline. You test at low resolution and low quality, then upscale only the keepers.

- Speed. If a concept isn't landing, we pivot in a day, not a week.

- Clear written English. Most communication is over Slack.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:



1. Your reel or portfolio - direct links. Call out the AI-generated work specifically and tell us which tools made which shots.

2. Your single best product-focused piece. One object, shot beautifully, beats a montage of everything you've ever made.

3. Any luxury or high-end brand work, if you have it.

4. Two or three sentences on how you keep a specific product consistent across a moving shot.



Start your reply with the word STARFORGE so we know you read the whole post.



OUR PROCESS



- We shortlist from reels.

- Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project - the same folder of renders for one ring, the same brief, 10 seconds. Everyone works from identical material so we can compare fairly. We pay for your time whether or not we hire you.

- Strongest result gets the role.



This is a long-term position. We're building the entire jewelry marketing operation and we want one person who owns video, understands the brand, and gets better at it over time - not someone who delivers three clips and moves on. If the work is outstanding, there's room to grow with us.

title: Estimating & Project Administration Coordinator
description:
Estimating & Project Administration Coordinator

Company: James Marsden Builders

Location: Remote, Philippines-based

Employment type: Full-time independent contractor

Pay: $10 AUD per hour

Working with: Brisbane-based residential construction company



James Marsden Builders is seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Estimating & Project Administration Coordinator to support our residential construction business.



We specialise in substantial home extensions and renovations generally valued between $250,000 and $1 million. This role will support our estimating, preconstruction, project administration, backcosting and cost-control systems.



The successful applicant will be trained in our processes, Australian construction terminology and software. You will initially work closely with the directors and existing administration team, with the opportunity to take ownership of repeatable workflows as your knowledge develops.



Key responsibilities

Review plans, scopes, selections and project information

Complete material take-offs and enter quantities into Wunderbuild

Request and follow up supplier and subcontractor pricing

Prepare draft estimates, proposals and supporting schedules

Identify missing information, exclusions, assumptions and pricing gaps

Prepare purchase orders for approval

Enter and allocate invoices, commitments and actual project costs

Maintain accurate project records and cost codes

Compare estimated, committed and actual costs

Identify cost variances, budget risks and missing expenses

Maintain project schedules, task lists and registers

Follow up suppliers, subcontractors and outstanding information

Help build estimating systems, checklists, templates and SOPs

Use AI and other tools where appropriate to improve speed and accuracy

What we are looking for

Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy

Excellent written and spoken English

Experience in construction administration, estimating, quantity surveying, project coordination or a related field

Ability to understand plans, construction terminology and project documentation

Strong organisational and time-management skills

Ability to follow documented processes accurately

Proactive approach to identifying problems and missing information

Willingness to ask questions and escalate issues when required

Experience creating or improving processes, checklists or SOPs

Experience with Wunderbuild or similar construction software is preferred, but not essential

Australian construction experience is advantageous but not required. We are willing to train the right person who is reliable, motivated and capable of learning quickly.



What success looks like

You produce accurate work that requires review, not reconstruction. Project information stays current, costs are correctly allocated, missing information is identified early, and our estimating and administration systems become easier for others to follow.



To apply, please send your CV, availability, relevant experience, examples of estimating or administration work, and a short explanation of how you check your work for accuracy.
