title: Digital Growth & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week | Long-Term Opportunity | European Health & Beauty Business



We are looking for a highly capable, organised and commercially minded Digital Growth & Marketing Virtual Assistant to join a growing premium health, beauty and wellness company based in Iceland.



This is not a basic admin VA role.



We are looking for someone who is confident working independently across Meta Ads, Klaviyo, Shopify, Notion and digital marketing systems and who enjoys taking ownership, improving processes and turning ideas into well-executed campaigns.



You will work directly with the Founder/CEO, but the goal is not for you to wait for daily instructions.



We want someone who can gradually own the recurring digital marketing execution, keep projects moving, monitor performance, identify opportunities and bring recommendations — not just complete assigned tasks.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Meta Ads



* Build and manage Meta advertising campaigns

* Monitor campaign performance and budget pacing

* Optimise existing campaigns based on data

* Set up and manage creative tests

* Check tracking and conversion events

* Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend improvements

* Prepare clear performance summaries and next actions



Klaviyo /
 Marketing



* Build and manage
 campaigns

* Create and improve automated flows

* Build segments and audience logic

* Set up triggers and conditional splits

* Monitor
 and flow performance

* Test subject lines, content and CTAs

* Maintain QA and deliverability standards

* Identify opportunities to generate more revenue from our existing database



Shopify & Landing Pages



* Build and update landing pages

* Create products, offers and discount codes

* Update website banners and campaign content

* Make routine website updates

* QA customer journeys and campaign pages

* Troubleshoot basic Shopify issues



Experience with Shopify Liquid/custom sections is a strong advantage.



Campaign Execution

You will help turn approved marketing ideas into complete campaigns from beginning to end.



This may include:



Campaign brief → landing page → Meta campaign → Klaviyo
s → website updates → creative assets → tracking → QA → launch → optimisation → reporting.



We want our campaigns prepared well ahead of launch, rather than being built reactively at the last minute.



Social Media & Content



* Help maintain a structured content calendar

* Prepare and organise content ahead of publication

* Create/adapt content using Canva and existing brand assets

* Repurpose existing content intelligently

* Research content ideas and opportunities

* Help improve content based on actual performance



Blog & SEO



* Research relevant topics and customer questions

* Maintain a structured blog/content calendar

* Prepare SEO-focused content briefs and drafts

* Publish/update content where appropriate

* Connect content to relevant services, offers and customer journeys



Systems, Automation & Notion



* Maintain our Growth & Marketing workspace in Notion

* Keep campaigns, deadlines, priorities and approvals organised

* Document recurring processes and create SOPs/checklists

* Identify repetitive work that can be automated

* Build or improve workflows using tools such as Zapier and AI

* Help us make our marketing operation simpler and more efficient over time



The Person We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have hands-on experience with Meta Ads

* Have strong practical experience with Klaviyo

* Are comfortable managing Shopify

* Are highly organised in Notion

* Are confident using Canva

* Understand digital funnels, conversion tracking and customer journeys

* Are comfortable using AI tools intelligently

* Have experience with automation tools such as Zapier

* Understand marketing KPIs and can interpret performance data

* Have excellent written English

* Learn new software quickly

* Have very strong attention to detail

* Can manage recurring responsibilities without constant reminders

* Think in systems and processes

* Naturally look for ways to improve how things are done



Most importantly, you are someone who can say:



“I noticed this isn’t performing as expected. Here is what I found, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



Rather than simply waiting to be told what to do.



How We Work



We use Notion as our central operating system.



Your tasks, projects, campaign pipeline, deadlines, documentation and time tracking will be managed there.



We believe in clear ownership and communication.



For recurring responsibilities, the goal is that you eventually know what needs to happen, when it needs to happen and what good performance looks like without needing the CEO to assign every individual task.



We also value documentation. If something becomes recurring, we want to turn it into a repeatable process, checklist, template or automation.



About The House of Beauty



The House of Beauty is a premium, multi-award-winning health, wellness and non-invasive body clinic based in Reykjavík, Iceland.



We have been operating for 8+ years and have delivered 50,000+ treatments.



Our clients are primarily women, and our brand combines premium client experience with specialist expertise, technology and results-focused treatments.



We are now strengthening the systems behind the business and building a more structured, measurable and scalable growth operation.



Important: Our Marketing Is Primarily in Icelandic



You do not need to speak Icelandic.



However, you must be comfortable working with approved Icelandic copy, historical campaigns, AI-assisted workflows and structured review processes.



You should never guess or independently publish Icelandic customer-facing copy if you are uncertain about its meaning.



Hours & Compensation



* 20 hours per week ongoing

* Initial onboarding/build period may require additional agreed hours

* $6 USD/hour

* Long-term opportunity for the right person

* Remote position

* Paid hourly with time tracking

* Initial 3-month probationary period



We care more about quality, ownership, reliability and output than simply logging hours.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Start your application with the words: “THOB Growth”

This helps us confirm that you read the full job description.



2. Tell us about your experience with:



* Meta Ads

* Klaviyo

* Shopify

* Notion

* Zapier/automation

* Canva



3. Rate yourself from 1–10 in each of those six tools.



4. Give us one real example of a marketing system, campaign or automation you personally built or significantly improved.

Explain:



* What was the problem?

* What did you personally do?

* What was the result?



5. Imagine you join us and discover that one of our Meta campaigns has been performing significantly worse for the last 10 days. What would you check before recommending what we should do?



6. How many hours per week are you currently committed to other clients or employment?



7. What is your current working schedule and timezone?



8. Please include links or screenshots of relevant work where possible.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview.

title: Senior Outbound Campaign Lead (Results Ownership | Strategy + Execution + Systems)
description:
We are hiring a Senior Outbound Campaign Lead to fully own outbound performance across multiple premium client accounts.



Veritas AI Agency is a boutique, fast-growing agency serving high-end travel and luxury brands. This is not a task-based execution role and not a junior VA position. You will design, launch, manage, and optimize outbound email and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end, with clear ownership of results. Experience is a must.



This role requires prior hands-on experience running cold outbound email campaigns. If you have not personally owned cold outbound campaigns end-to-end, this role will not be a fit.



You will manage 3–5 concurrent client accounts, owning strategy, execution, deliverability, optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. This role requires someone who thinks like both an operator and a strategist — identifying issues early, testing solutions, and proactively improving outcomes.



This is a long-term Independent Contractor role for someone seeking stability, ownership, and growth within a high-standards agency where you will be treated as part of the team. You will work closely with the Founder and be trusted to operate independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication.



We are intentionally building a small, high-performing team of people who take pride in their work, think critically, and want to build something long-term. We move quickly, hold high standards, and value trust, integrity, and collaboration.



Who Thrives Here



This role is a great fit for someone who is:



• Results-oriented and takes full ownership of outcomes

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

• Proactive, solution-driven, and able to think independently

• High-integrity, reliable, and accountable

• A strong communicator who keeps leadership informed

• Comfortable using AI tools and automation as part of daily execution





What You Own (Non-Negotiable)



• Outbound results (replies, meetings, pipeline)

• Outbound campaign strategy aligned to client goals

• Cold email and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end

• Sequencing, volumes, targeting, and follow-ups

• Deliverability: domains, inbox setup, warm-up, monitoring

• Sustainable outbound performance with a strong emphasis on deliverability, list quality, and long-term inbox health (not brute-force volume).

• Ongoing optimization when results are not where they should be

• Outbound tech stack selection and management

• Reporting & Analysis: Weekly and monthly performance reviews with actionable insights for the Founder.

• Clear communication around performance, risks, and improvements

• Documenting proven execution into simple SOPs over time

• Occasional outbound calls to engaged prospects (e.g., following email or Linkedin outreach

engagement). This is low-volume, high-context outreach - not cold calling and not a call-center role.



AI & Automation Expectations



This role requires strong working knowledge of AI tools used to speed up outbound execution, analysis, and optimization. You are expected to:



• Use AI to accelerate copy iteration, personalization, and testing (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, or similar)

• Leverage AI for campaign analysis, pattern recognition, and optimization insights

• Build AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort while preserving quality

• Workflow Documentation: Experience creating and maintaining detailed documentation for AI-assisted workflows.



Required Experience & Skills



• 1–3+ years of hands-on experience running and optimizing outbound email and/or LinkedIn campaigns.

• Proven experience owning results, not just executing tasks.

• Strong understanding of deliverability and performance drivers.

• Hands-on experience with cold email platforms (Instantly or similar platforms).

• Experience selecting and managing outbound and AI-enabled tools.

• Familiarity with CRM systems for managing leads, pipeline, and outbound activity.

• Data Analysis: Demonstrated ability to interpret campaign KPIs and use data to drive optimization decisions.

• Niche Sensitivity: Demonstrated ability to research and write sophisticated, high-level copy that resonates with high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) or luxury clientele.

• Proficiency in modern remote collaboration and project management tools.

• Excellent written and verbal English and proactive communication.

• Comfortable speaking with senior-level executives in a professional, discreet manner when a prospect has already engaged. 

• Prior SDR, appointment setting, or BPO experience is a plus, but ONLY where calls were consultative, low volume, and relationship-oriented (not high volume cold calling). 





Work Schedule & Compensation



• Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST), every workday.

• Structure: This is an Independent Contractor (IC) role paid bi-weekly based on a fixed monthly rate. You are responsible for your own taxes, benefits, and equipment.

• Compensation: This role starts at $1,800 USD per month. Placement within the $1,800–$2,000 range is based on experience, speed of ramp, and demonstrated ownership of outbound results.

•Initial compensation is confirmed after a 60-day ramp period to validate execution quality, reliability, and results trajectory. •Performance-based bonuses of up to $500 per month are available after the initial 60 days and are tied directly to achieving agreed-upon outbound metrics (e.g., qualified sales meetings booked).

• Review: 60-day performance review focused on stability, execution quality, and results trajectory.



Application Instructions



When applying, please:



• Confirm that you can work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST every workday. Some occasional before/after hours during critical times.

• Niche Copy Test: Imagine you are writing a cold email on behalf of a private jet charter company to the CEO of a large company who regularly flies privately. Write the email, first three sentences only. The tone should be personal, discreet, and credible, and the message should naturally invite a reply or short conversation. Avoid using buzzwords, hard selling, or exaggerated claims.

• Briefly describe one outbound campaign you owned, including goals and results.

• Briefly describe how you currently use AI in outbound campaigns (copy, personalization, analysis, or automation).

• Applications that do not include the requested campaign details will not be reviewed.

title: Microsoft Excel & SharePoint Tutor – Saturdays
description:
Microsoft Excel & SharePoint Tutor – Saturdays



I’m looking for an experienced tutor to provide one-on-one training specifically in Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.

We will be starting from the ground up, assuming no prior knowledge, and gradually progressing from beginner fundamentals to more advanced, practical workplace skills.

I’m looking for hands-on training rather than simply watching video lessons. My goal is to become comfortable and efficient using both systems in a professional/corporate environment.



Main areas:

- Microsoft Excel — starting with the basics and progressing to formulas, functions, tables, PivotTables, data organization, reporting, lookups, and general efficiency

- Microsoft SharePoint — starting with basic navigation and progressing to document libraries, file management, sharing, permissions, collaboration, lists, and everyday professional use

Schedule: 2 hours every Saturday



Ideally, I’m looking for someone who has significant professional experience using both Excel and SharePoint and is comfortable teaching a complete beginner.

When applying, please tell me your experience and proficiency level with both Excel and SharePoint, as well as how you would structure the training to take someone from zero knowledge to professional working proficiency.

title: Remote Clinical Chart Prep Nurse (U.S. Outpatient Clinic)
description:
**About the Role**



We're hiring a Philippines-based Registered Nurse to prepare patient charts for a U.S. clinic before each clinic day. Your work helps providers start the day with the right clinical context already in place. The clinic uses an AI scribe during visits, so the goal is focused, concise prep that doesn't duplicate what the scribe already covers.



**What You'll Do**



- Review upcoming appointments and prepare charts after U.S. clinic hours

- Identify each visit's purpose, relevant prior visits, history, and chronic medications

- Complete chart-prep steps in the electronic medical record (EMR) following the clinic's guidelines

- Keep chart prep accurate and concise, and flag missing or unclear information instead of making assumptions

- Communicate questions and recurring workflow issues to the clinic team



**What We're Looking For**



- Registered Nurse (Philippine license) with hands-on clinical experience

- Strong attention to detail and sound judgment about what's clinically relevant to a visit

- Experience with EMRs and comfort learning new systems

- Clear, accurate written English

- Reliable internet and a quiet, private workspace suitable for handling patient information

- Ability to work independently on a schedule aligned with the U.S. clinic day



**Nice to Have (Not Required)**



- Experience in a U.S. outpatient clinic

- Prior remote chart-prep or medical virtual assistant experience



A U.S. nursing license is **not** required. The clinic will provide training on its chart-prep workflow.



**Hiring Process**

1. Initial screening for clinical experience

2. A short chart-prep exercise using de-identified sample records

3. Final interview



**How to Apply**



Please submit the following:

1.Updated resume

2. Video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering your nursing background, clinical experience, and the EMR systems you've used

3. Use this subject line "RN Chart Prep – [Your Full Name]"



**Incomplete applications will not be considered.**

title: Preoperative and Postoperative Phone Call RN
description:
Remote Preoperative and Postoperative Patient Call Coordinator

Job type: Full-time, remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week, with flexible shifts Monday through Saturday between 8:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Optional additional hours may be available.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced, compassionate coordinator to support patients before and after surgery at our ambulatory surgery centers. You will typically work with one primary center and assist nurses at other centers as patient volumes and workloads change.

This position involves speaking with patients, following approved call workflows, documenting responses, and promptly bringing clinical concerns to the attention of a nurse or other licensed clinician.

Responsibilities

- Make preoperative calls to patients scheduled for surgery. Confirm required information, review approved preparation instructions, and document questions or concerns.

- Make postoperative follow-up calls. Ask approved recovery questions, document patient responses, and escalate reported symptoms or concerns according to center procedures.

- Provide reassurance and clear information while staying within the role’s approved instructions.

- Relay pertinent information to nurses and other members of the surgical team.

- Help coordinate follow-up calls or appointments when directed.

- Maintain accurate records in the electronic health record.

- Protect patient privacy and handle sensitive information confidentially.

- Track hours worked and completed work in our online portal.

- Support other centers when case volumes or nursing workloads change.

Required qualifications

- Experience in healthcare administration, patient coordination, nursing, or a related patient-facing role.

- Clear, fluent spoken and written English.

- Knowledge of medical terminology and familiarity with surgical care.

- Excellent phone communication, organization, and attention to detail.

- Ability to follow established workflows and promptly escalate clinical concerns.

- Experience using electronic health records or similar healthcare software.

Mandatory remote work requirements

- Reliable high-speed internet.

- A PC with a camera and speakers.

- Noise-canceling headphones.

- A quiet, private workspace free from interruptions during scheduled work hours.

- Ability to work scheduled shifts within the stated Pacific Time hours and record hours and work production in our online portal.

Preferred qualifications

- Nursing, medical assisting, or other relevant healthcare training or credentials.

- Experience making preoperative or postoperative patient calls.

- Ambulatory surgery center experience.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and U.S. patient privacy practices.

Professional development

Opportunities for professional development and continuing education in healthcare.

How to apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter describing your patient phone-call experience, surgical or ambulatory surgery center experience, English proficiency, and remote work setup.

title: Cinematic Travel Series Producer (Hospitality & Lifestyle)
description:

Can you take beautifully shot travel footage and shape it into something emotionally compelling?



Can you create hospitality storytelling that feels refined, immersive, and intentional — not loud or influencer-driven?



If you understand pacing, presence, and emotional resonance in editing… keep reading.



Cinematic Travel Series Editor



Go Travel Community | Hospitality-Driven Travel Brand



About Go Travel Community



Go Travel Community is not a booking site.

We are not a traditional travel agency.



We are building a belief-led hospitality ecosystem rooted in:



• Intentional travel

• Meaningful community

• Elevated experiences

• Human connection

• Impact-driven exploration



Our brand exists at the intersection of hospitality, storytelling, and emotional resonance.



We are launching a Virgin Voyages travel content series and are seeking a skilled Video Editor to transform captured footage into a cohesive, emotionally intelligent long-form episode and supporting social content.



This is not influencer-style “look at me” content.

This is not loud luxury.



This is refined, emotionally grounded hospitality storytelling.



Our tone:

80% emotion

20% intellect

Calm confidence

Elevated but inclusive

Story-driven, never salesy



The content should make viewers feel:

Present

Inspired

Expanded

Curious

Part of something bigger



Role Overview



This is a post-production focused role.



All footage will be professionally captured and provided.

You will collaborate closely with a founder-led brand to shape narrative, pacing, tone, and emotional arc.



We are looking for someone who understands cinematic storytelling — not just technical cutting.



This is a flexible, project-based opportunity with potential for ongoing collaboration as the series expands.



Key Responsibilities



• Edit one long-form episode (approximately 30–45 minutes)

• Shape strong emotional and narrative structure from provided footage

• Create multiple vertical short-form edits (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

• Apply intentional pacing and music selection

• Perform clean, polished color grading

• Integrate immersive but subtle sound design

• Collaborate creatively while remaining efficient and organized

• Deliver structured final files and project assets



Required Skills & Experience



• Strong cinematic storytelling sensibility

• Advanced proficiency in professional editing software

• Experience editing long-form content (30+ minutes)

• Ability to balance luxury aesthetics with authenticity

• Understanding of hospitality, lifestyle, or travel branding

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Ability to work within defined scope and timelines



Preferred Experience



• Travel or hospitality editing experience

• Documentary-style pacing

• Experience creating both long-form and short-form content from the same footage

• Familiarity with YouTube storytelling structure

• Understanding of emotionally intelligent brand positioning



Deliverables Expectations (Per Episode)



• One long-form episode (30–45 minutes)

• 3–6 vertical short-form cuts

• Clean audio balance and music integration

• Light color correction and polish

• Organized project file delivery



Final scope and number of short-form edits will be aligned prior to project start to ensure clarity and creative focus.



Tone & Creative Alignment



Your editing should prioritize:



• Presence over hype

• Atmosphere over spectacle

• Emotion over ego

• Story over sales



We are not documenting luxury for display.

We are capturing hospitality as a lived, shared experience.



What Success Looks Like



• Viewers feel transported, not marketed to

• The brand feels cohesive and elevated

• The storytelling feels intentional and emotionally resonant

• The founder feels creatively supported

• The audience feels like they belong



Compensation



$12 – $15 per hour

(approximately ?670 – ?850 per hour, depending on exchange rate)



Estimated per episode range: $500 – $700 USD



Compensation is based on experience, efficiency, and portfolio strength.



Opportunity for ongoing collaboration as we continue building our long-form travel series.



If your editing style is thoughtful, refined, and emotionally aware — we would love to see your work.



Please apply with:



• Portfolio or reel

• One example of long-form storytelling

• Examples of short-form edits

• A brief note describing your approach to hospitality or travel storytelling



Thank You!

title: Marketing & Business Operations Coordinator

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM U.S. Pacific Time

30-minute unpaid lunch

40 paid hours per week

Previous long-term experience working a U.S. night/graveyard schedule is strongly preferred.

• Maintain accurate leads, pipeline stages, follow-ups, tasks, and next actions

• Help ensure leads and customer opportunities do not fall through the cracks

• Eventually communicate with U.S. customers to confirm appointments, schedule meetings, and handle routine follow-up

• Publish and update website and blog content in WordPress

• Maintain and improve SOPs, checklists, documentation, and recurring processes

• Use ChatGPT and Claude professionally for research, writing, analysis, and problem-solving

• Assist with general business administration and operational tasks as needed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Excellent spoken English with high fluency, clear pronunciation, and the ability to communicate naturally and professionally with U.S. customers

• Excellent written English

• Strong CRM and lead-management experience

• Experience implementing, organizing, or improving a CRM is a strong advantage

• Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and follow-through

• Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently

• Strong problem-solving ability and good judgment

• Digital marketing or marketing-support experience

• Hands-on WordPress and Canva experience

• Professional experience using ChatGPT and Claude

A bachelor's degree is strongly preferred, particularly in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. Strong candidates with relevant experience will still be considered without a bachelor's degree.

• At least one 24-inch or larger external monitor
